jobs.title: Brand Experience Specialist
jobs.description:
Location: La Tour-de-Peilz, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As a Brand Experience Specialist at Nestlé Suisse S.A., your mission is to rejuvenate THOMY and deepen consumer loyalty by delivering integrated brand experiences that strengthen emotional connection and drive sustainable growth. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with marketing, sales, communications, food-service teams, agencies and sponsorship partners. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Brand Experience Specialist

• Turning consumer, cultural and category insights into compelling brand experiences that grow brand relevance and commercial impact.

• Shaping an omnichannel activation strategy that creates a seamless THOMY experience across the OOH / convenience channel.

• Activating an external network to build high-value local sponsorship partnerships that expand visibility, strengthen brand meaning and unlock sustainable growth.

• Developing and executing brand activations, live marketing events and brand experiences that convert participation into lasting loyalty, engagement and advocacy.

• Delivering integrated amplification plans that connect every activation to brand priorities and measurable business outcomes.

• Driving excellent execution through clear collaboration, smart resource allocation and continuous learning from results.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in brand marketing, consumer activation, communications, or shopper marketing, while acting as a passionate ambassador for THOMY both internally and externally.

• Applying Out-of-Home market knowledge to deliver integrated omnichannel activations that strengthen brand visibility and drive business results across the region, supported by the flexibility to travel regularly and a valid driver's license.

• Using consumer insights, performance metrics, and budget management expertise to optimize execution, measure effectiveness, and maximize return on investment.

• Collaborating effectively with agencies, external partners, and cross-functional teams while leading projects from brief to successful implementation.

• Communicating fluently in Swiss German/German and English.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed, and continuous learning.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to a fair and transparent internal hiring process and ensure all applications are treated confidentially.

Your application will typically include an initial review, conversations with Talent Acquisition and the hiring team, followed by a final discussion.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: La Tour-de-Peilz, Svizzera
Modello di lavoro: ibrido / tempo pieno
Tipo di contratto / durata: Permanente

Essere una forza per il bene e crescere attraverso esperienze che ti spingono oltre

In qualità di Brand Experience Specialist presso Nestlé Suisse S.A., la vostra missione è di ringiovanire THOMY e approfondire la lealtà dei consumatori offrendo esperienze di brand integrate che rafforzano la connessione emotiva e spingono la crescita sostenibile. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con marketing, vendite, comunicazioni, team di food-service, agenzie e partner di sponsorizzazione. Questa è la vostra opportunità di prendere la proprietà, crescere la vostra esperienza, e fare la differenza in scala.

Come farete un impatto come specialista di Brand Experience

• Trasformando intuizioni di consumatori, culturali e di categoria in esperienze di marca convincenti che crescono la rilevanza del marchio e l'impatto commerciale.

• Definire una strategia di attivazione omnicanale che crea un'esperienza di THOMY senza soluzione di continuità attraverso il canale OOH / convenienza.

• Attivare una rete esterna per costruire partnership di sponsorizzazione locali di alto valore che espandono la visibilità, rafforzino il significato del marchio e sbloccano la crescita sostenibile.

• Sviluppare ed eseguire le attivazioni del marchio, eventi di marketing dal vivo e le esperienze del marchio che convertono la partecipazione in una duratura fedeltà, impegno e advocacy.

• Fornire piani di amplificazione integrati che collegano ogni attivazione alle priorità del marchio e risultati aziendali misurabili.

• Guidare l'esecuzione eccellente attraverso una collaborazione chiara, allocazione intelligente delle risorse e apprendimento continuo dai risultati.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portando una forte esperienza nel marketing del marchio, nell'attivazione dei consumatori, nelle comunicazioni o nel marketing degli shopper, agendo come ambasciatore appassionato di THOMY sia internamente che esternamente.

• Applicando conoscenze di mercato Out-of-Home per fornire attivazioni omnichannel integrate che rafforzano la visibilità del marchio e i risultati aziendali di guida in tutta la regione, supportato dalla flessibilità di viaggiare regolarmente e dalla valida licenza del conducente.

• Utilizzando le conoscenze dei consumatori, le metriche delle prestazioni e le competenze di gestione del bilancio per ottimizzare l'esecuzione, misurare l'efficacia e massimizzare il ritorno sugli investimenti.

• Collaborare efficacemente con le agenzie, i partner esterni e i team interfunzionali, mentre i progetti principali da breve a successo implementazione.

• Comunicare fluentemente in tedesco / tedesco svizzero e inglese.

• Dimostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo.

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Ci impegniamo a un processo di assunzione interno equo e trasparente e assicuriamo che tutte le applicazioni siano trattate con riservatezza.

La tua applicazione in genere includerà una recensione iniziale, conversazioni con Talent Acquisition e il team di assunzione, seguita da una discussione finale.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronti a crescere con noi?

Applicare ora e crescere attraverso esperienze che ti spingono oltre.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Standort: La Tour-de-Peilz, Schweiz
Arbeitsmodell: Hybrid / Vollzeit
Vertragsart/Dauer: Permanent

Sei eine Kraft für das Gute und wachse durch Erfahrungen, die dich weiter bringen

Als Brand Experience Specialist bei Nestlé Suisse S.A. ist es Ihre Mission, THOMY zu verjüngen und die Kundenbindung zu vertiefen, indem Sie integrierte Markenerlebnisse liefern, die die emotionale Verbindung stärken und nachhaltiges Wachstum vorantreiben. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit Marketing, Vertrieb, Kommunikation, Food-Service-Teams, Agenturen und Sponsoring-Partnern zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Eigenverantwortung zu übernehmen, Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und einen großen Unterschied zu machen.

Wie Sie als Brand Experience Specialist etwas bewirken

• Verwandeln Sie Verbraucher-, Kultur- und Kategorieerkenntnisse in überzeugende Markenerlebnisse, die Markenrelevanz und kommerzielle Auswirkungen erhöhen.

• Gestaltung einer Omnichannel-Aktivierungsstrategie, die ein nahtloses THOMY-Erlebnis über den OOH / Convenience-Kanal schafft.

• Aktivierung eines externen Netzwerks zum Aufbau hochwertiger lokaler Sponsoring-Partnerschaften, die die Sichtbarkeit erhöhen, die Markenbedeutung stärken und nachhaltiges Wachstum ermöglichen.

• Entwicklung und Durchführung von Markenaktivierungen, Live-Marketing-Events und Markenerfahrungen, die die Teilnahme in dauerhafte Loyalität, Engagement und Interessenvertretung umwandeln.

• Bereitstellung integrierter Verstärkungspläne, die jede Aktivierung mit Markenprioritäten und messbaren Geschäftsergebnissen verbinden.

• Führen Sie eine hervorragende Ausführung durch klare Zusammenarbeit, intelligente Ressourcenzuweisung und kontinuierliches Lernen aus den Ergebnissen.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Wir bringen starkes Know-how in den Bereichen Markenmarketing, Verbraucheraktivierung, Kommunikation oder Käufermarketing mit und sind gleichzeitig als leidenschaftlicher Botschafter für THOMY sowohl intern als auch extern tätig.

• Anwendung von Out-of-Home-Marktwissen, um integrierte Omnichannel-Aktivierungen zu liefern, die die Markensichtbarkeit stärken und die Geschäftsergebnisse in der Region steigern, unterstützt durch die Flexibilität, regelmäßig zu reisen und einen gültigen Führerschein.

• Verwendung von Consumer Insights, Performance-Metriken und Budgetmanagement-Expertise zur Optimierung der Ausführung, Messung der Effektivität und Maximierung des Return on Investment.

• Effektive Zusammenarbeit mit Agenturen, externen Partnern und funktionsübergreifenden Teams, während Projekte von der kurzen bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung geleitet werden.

• Fließend kommunizieren in Schweizer Deutsch/Deutsch und Englisch.

• Demonstration von Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierlichem Lernen.

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einem fairen und transparenten internen Einstellungsprozess und stellen sicher, dass alle Bewerbungen vertraulich behandelt werden.

Ihre Bewerbung umfasst in der Regel eine erste Überprüfung, Gespräche mit Talent Acquisition und dem Einstellungsteam, gefolgt von einer abschließenden Diskussion.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird Kandidaten nur über offizielle Firmen-E-Mail-Adressen kontaktieren und zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Einstellungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

Bereit, mit uns zu wachsen?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und wachsen Sie durch Erfahrungen, die Sie weiter vorantreiben.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Lieu: La Tour-de-Peilz, Suisse
Modèle de travail: Hybride / Temps plein
Type / durée du contrat : Permanent

Être une force pour le bien et grandir à travers des expériences qui vous poussent plus loin

En tant que spécialiste de l'expérience de la marque chez Nestlé Suisse S.A., votre mission est de rajeunir THOMY et d'approfondir la loyauté des consommateurs en offrant des expériences de marque intégrées qui renforcent la connexion émotionnelle et stimulent une croissance durable. Vous ferez une différence en collaborant étroitement avec le marketing, les ventes, les communications, les équipes de services alimentaires, les agences et les partenaires de parrainage. C'est l'occasion pour vous de prendre en main, de développer votre expertise et de faire une différence à l'échelle.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que spécialiste de l'expérience de la marque

• Transformer les connaissances des consommateurs, des cultures et des catégories en expériences de marque convaincantes qui augmentent la pertinence de la marque et son impact commercial.

• Façonner une stratégie d'activation omnicanale qui crée une expérience THOMY transparente à travers le canal OOH / pratique.

• Activer un réseau externe pour créer des partenariats de parrainage locaux de grande valeur qui accroissent la visibilité, renforcent le sens de la marque et permettent une croissance durable.

• Développer et exécuter des activations de marque, des événements de marketing en direct et des expériences de marque qui transforment la participation en fidélité, engagement et plaidoyer durables.

• Fournir des plans d'amplification intégrés qui relient chaque activation aux priorités de marque et aux résultats opérationnels mesurables.

• Conduire une excellente exécution grâce à une collaboration claire, une allocation intelligente des ressources et un apprentissage continu des résultats.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter une solide expertise dans le marketing de marque, l'activation des consommateurs, les communications, ou le marketing d'achat, tout en agissant comme un ambassadeur passionné de THOMY à l'interne et à l'externe.

• Appliquer les connaissances du marché extérieur pour offrir des activations omnicanales intégrées qui renforcent la visibilité de la marque et stimulent les résultats commerciaux dans toute la région, soutenues par la flexibilité de voyager régulièrement et un permis de conduire valide.

• Utiliser les connaissances des consommateurs, les mesures du rendement et l'expertise en gestion budgétaire pour optimiser l'exécution, mesurer l'efficacité et maximiser le rendement des investissements.

• Collaborer efficacement avec les organismes, les partenaires externes et les équipes interfonctionnelles tout en menant des projets de courte durée à une mise en oeuvre réussie.

• Communiquer couramment en allemand/allemand et en anglais.

• Démontrer le courage, la collaboration, la rapidité et l'apprentissage continu.

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous nous engageons à mettre en place un processus d'embauche interne équitable et transparent et nous veillons à ce que toutes les demandes soient traitées de façon confidentielle.

Votre demande comprendra généralement un examen initial, des conversations avec Talent Acquisition et l'équipe d'embauche, suivies d'une discussion finale.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé communiquera uniquement avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses électroniques officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à n'importe quelle étape du processus d'embauche.

Prêt à grandir avec nous ?

Appliquer maintenant et grandir à travers des expériences qui vous poussent plus loin.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
Location and work model: La-Tour-de-Peilz, with regular customer visits across Switzerland and a remote working policy
Contract type / duration: Permanent
Activity rate: 80–100%

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Key Account Manager at Nestlé Purina PetCare Switzerland, your mission is to own and steer the commercial performance of strategic retail customers in Switzerland, delivering sustainable growth, profitability, market share and excellent execution. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with customer stakeholders and with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain and key support teams. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and deliver meaningful results that make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Key Account Manager

• Leading the commercial performance of assigned retail customers, taking ownership of sales, profitability, market share, distribution, forecasting and trade investment outcomes

• Driving customer strategy and joint business planning that translate category priorities into strong customer plans and sustainable profitable growth

• Building trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders and leading impactful negotiations supported by strong financial insight, clear priorities and sound investment choices

• Steering accurate customer forecasting, baseline and promotional planning, while driving best-in-class execution of promotions, launches, distribution initiatives and commercial plans to strengthen customer and category performance

• Turning shopper, category, customer and financial insights into fact-based recommendations that improve business performance and decision-making

• Aligning cross-functional teams around customer priorities, enabling focused execution and creating shared value for customers, consumers and Purina

What will make you successful

• Bringing relevant expertise gained through education or professional experience combined with proven track record in solid key account management in fast-moving consumer goods or retail, with proven ownership of customer growth, profitability and market share

• Bringing eCommerce experience would be a strong asset

• Applying strong commercial and financial acumen to manage customer performance, trade investments, forecasting, budgeting and profitability decisions

• Using negotiation, customer planning and relationship-building skills to influence senior stakeholders and deliver mutually valuable business outcome

• Collaborating across functions with confidence, resilience and accountability to turn strategies, insights and priorities into excellent execution

• Communicating fluently in German and English, French is an advantage.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value

At Nestlé Purina PetCare Switzerland, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Luogo e modello di lavoro: La-Tour-de-Peilz, con regolari visite al cliente in Svizzera e una politica di lavoro remota
Tipo di contratto / durata: Permanente
Tasso di attività: 80-100%

Essere una forza per il cambiamento buono e accelera che migliora la vita e il pianeta

In qualità di Key Account Manager presso Nestlé Purina PetCare Svizzera, la vostra missione è quella di possedere e sostenere le prestazioni commerciali dei clienti strategici di vendita al dettaglio in Svizzera, offrendo una crescita sostenibile, redditività, quota di mercato e un'eccellente esecuzione. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con le parti interessate del cliente e con i team di vendita, marketing, finanza, supply chain e supporto chiave. Questa è la vostra opportunità di prendere la proprietà, crescere la vostra esperienza, e fornire risultati significativi che fanno la differenza in scala.

Come fare un impatto come Key Account Manager

• Conducendo le prestazioni commerciali dei clienti retail assegnati, assumendo la proprietà di vendite, redditività, quota di mercato, distribuzione, previsione e risultati di investimento commerciale

• Guidare la strategia del cliente e la pianificazione aziendale congiunta che traducono le priorità di categoria in piani clienti forti e crescita redditizia sostenibile

• Costruire relazioni di fiducia con le principali parti interessate dei clienti e i principali negoziati di impatto sostenuti da una forte comprensione finanziaria, priorità chiare e scelte di investimento solide

• Prospettive accurate del cliente, base e pianificazione promozionale, mentre guida l'esecuzione migliore in classe di promozioni, lanci, iniziative di distribuzione e piani commerciali per rafforzare le prestazioni del cliente e della categoria

• Trasformare shopper, categoria, clienti e intuizioni finanziarie in raccomandazioni basate sul fatto che migliorano le prestazioni aziendali e il processo decisionale

• Allineare i team interfunzionali attorno alle priorità dei clienti, consentendo l'esecuzione focalizzata e creando valore condiviso per clienti, consumatori e Purina

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare competenze rilevanti acquisite attraverso l'istruzione o l'esperienza professionale combinata con il record di tracciato collaudato nella gestione di conti chiave solida in beni di consumo in rapida evoluzione o al dettaglio, con comprovata proprietà della crescita del cliente, della redditività e della quota di mercato

• Portare l'esperienza eCommerce sarebbe un bene forte

• Applicare un forte acume commerciale e finanziario per gestire le prestazioni del cliente, gli investimenti commerciali, le previsioni, le decisioni di budget e redditività

• Utilizzo di negoziazione, pianificazione del cliente e capacità di costruzione di relazioni per influenzare gli stakeholder senior e fornire risultati di business reciprocamente preziosi

• Collaborare tra funzioni con fiducia, resilienza e responsabilità per trasformare strategie, intuizioni e priorità in esecuzione eccellente

• Comunicare fluentemente in tedesco e inglese, il francese è un vantaggio.

• Dimostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo, traducendo le idee in un impatto misurabile e creando valore condiviso

A Nestlé Purina PetCare Svizzera, mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto quello che facciamo

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti dei dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione include tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che un forte elenco di candidati pertinenti è identificato, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto ad essere una Forza per il Bene?

Applicare ora e accelerare il cambiamento che migliora le vite e il pianeta.

Standort und Arbeitsmodell: La-Tour-de-Peilz, mit regelmäßigen Kundenbesuchen in der ganzen Schweiz und einer Remote-Arbeitspolitik
Vertragsart/Dauer: Permanent
Aktivitätsrate: 80–100%

Sei eine Kraft für das Gute und beschleunige Veränderungen, die das Leben und den Planeten verbessern

Als Key Account Manager bei Nestlé Purina PetCare Schweiz ist es Ihre Mission, die kommerzielle Leistung strategischer Einzelhandelskunden in der Schweiz zu besitzen und zu steuern, um nachhaltiges Wachstum, Rentabilität, Marktanteil und eine hervorragende Ausführung zu erzielen. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit Kundeninteressenten und mit Sales, Marketing, Finanzen, Supply Chain und wichtigen Supportteams zusammenarbeiten. Wie Sie als Key Account Manager etwas bewirken

• Förderung der Kundenstrategie und der gemeinsamen Geschäftsplanung, die die Prioritäten der Kategorie in starke Kundenpläne und nachhaltiges profitables Wachstum umsetzen

• Aufbau vertrauensvoller Beziehungen zu wichtigen Kundeninteressenten und Leitung wirkungsvoller Verhandlungen, unterstützt durch starke finanzielle Erkenntnisse, klare Prioritäten und solide Anlageentscheidungen

• Lenken Sie genaue Kundenprognosen, Baseline- und Promotion-Planung, während Sie die erstklassige Ausführung von Promotions, Starts, Vertriebsinitiativen und kommerziellen Plänen vorantreiben, um die Leistung von Kunden und Kategorien zu stärken

• Umwandlung von Käufer-, Kategorie-, Kunden- und Finanzinformationen in faktenbasierte Empfehlungen, die die Geschäftsleistung und Entscheidungsfindung verbessern

• Ausrichtung funktionsübergreifender Teams auf Kundenprioritäten, um eine fokussierte Ausführung zu ermöglichen und einen gemeinsamen Wert für Kunden, Verbraucher und Purina zu schaffen

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Mitbringen relevanter Expertise, die durch Ausbildung oder Berufserfahrung gewonnen wurde, kombiniert mit nachgewiesener Erfolgsbilanz im soliden Key-Account-Management in schnelllebigen Konsumgütern oder im Einzelhandel, mit nachgewiesener Eigenverantwortung für Kundenwachstum, Rentabilität und Marktanteil

• Funktionenübergreifend mit Vertrauen, Belastbarkeit und Verantwortlichkeit zusammenarbeiten, um Strategien, Erkenntnisse und Prioritäten in eine hervorragende Ausführung zu verwandeln

• Fließend in Deutsch und Englisch zu kommunizieren, ist Französisch von Vorteil.

• Demonstrieren von Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierlichem Lernen, während Ideen in messbare Auswirkungen übersetzt und gemeinsame Werte geschaffen werden

Location and work model: Home-based position in Switzerland, with regular travel to visit clients across the country and regular visits in our head office in La Tour-De-Peilz
Contract type / duration: Permanent
Activity rate: 80-100%

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Key Account Manager at Nestlé Professional, your mission is to acquire, develop and strategically manage key accounts across the out-of-home food and beverage channel, delivering sustainable sales growth and profitability through tailored culinary and beverage solutions. You’ll make a difference by identifying new business opportunities and building trusted partnerships with customers, operators and distributors, in close collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Finance and Supply Chain teams. This is an opportunity to combine strategic account leadership with an entrepreneurial and consultative approach in a dynamic market.

How you’ll make an impact as a Key Account Manager

• Developing existing and new out-of-home key accounts by translating customer, channel and market insights into tailored growth opportunities

• Identifying and converting new business opportunities across out-of-home foodservice environments

• Building trusted relationships with customers, operators and distributors to co-create culinary, coffee and beverage solutions that respond to their operational and commercial needs

• Leading consultative commercial discussions and business reviews that strengthen customer performance, profitability and long-term partnerships

• Using distributor networks and cross-functional expertise to expand Nestlé Professional’s presence and bring customer solutions successfully to market

• Acting with an entrepreneurial mindset, taking ownership from opportunity identification through implementation and measurable commercial results

What will make you successful

• Bringing solid key account management and business development experience in foodservice, HoReCa or another out-of-home environment

• Understanding the out-of-home ecosystem, including the role of operators, distributors and different foodservice channels, and using these insights to identify growth opportunities

• Applying consultative and solution-based selling, commercial planning and negotiation capabilities to create tailored customer propositions and sustainable value

• Demonstrating a strong hunting mindset and the ability to acquire new customers while developing long-term strategic partnerships

• Communicating fluently in German and French. English is a plus.

• Working with autonomy, commercial curiosity and resilience, while collaborating across functions to turn opportunities into measurable results and shared value

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Tipo di contratto / durata: Permanente
Tasso di attività: 80-100%

Essere una forza per il cambiamento buono e accelera che migliora la vita e il pianeta

In qualità di Key Account Manager di Nestlé Professional, la vostra missione è quella di acquisire, sviluppare e gestire strategicamente i conti chiave attraverso il canale di cibo e bevande fuori casa, offrendo una crescita sostenibile delle vendite e la redditività attraverso soluzioni culinarie e bevande su misura. Farete la differenza individuando nuove opportunità di business e costruendo partnership di fiducia con clienti, operatori e distributori, in stretta collaborazione con i team Sales, Marketing, Finanza e Supply Chain. Questa è un'opportunità per combinare la leadership strategica del conto con un approccio imprenditoriale e consultivo in un mercato dinamico.

Come fare un impatto come Key Account Manager

• Sviluppare account chiave esistenti e nuovi out-of-home traducendo clienti, canali e informazioni di mercato in opportunità di crescita su misura

• Identificare e convertire nuove opportunità di business in ambienti foodservice fuori casa

• Costruire relazioni di fiducia con clienti, operatori e distributori per creare soluzioni culinarie, caffè e bevande che rispondono alle loro esigenze operative e commerciali

• Le principali discussioni commerciali consultive e le recensioni aziendali che rafforzano le prestazioni dei clienti, la redditività e le partnership a lungo termine

• Utilizzo di reti di distribuzione e competenze trasversali per espandere la presenza di Nestlé Professional e portare le soluzioni dei clienti al mercato

• Agire con una mentalità imprenditoriale, prendendo la proprietà dall'identificazione delle opportunità attraverso l'implementazione e risultati commerciali misurabili

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare solida gestione del conto chiave e l'esperienza di sviluppo aziendale in foodservice, HoReCa o un altro ambiente fuori casa

• Comprendere l'ecosistema fuori casa, compreso il ruolo di operatori, distributori e diversi canali di foodservice, e utilizzando queste informazioni per identificare le opportunità di crescita

• Applicare capacità di vendita, pianificazione commerciale e negoziazione con soluzioni consultive e basate su soluzioni per creare proposizioni personalizzate e valore sostenibile

• Dimostrare una forte mentalità di caccia e la capacità di acquisire nuovi clienti, sviluppando partnership strategiche a lungo termine

• Comunicare fluentemente in tedesco e francese. L'inglese è un vantaggio.

• Lavorare con autonomia, curiosità commerciale e resilienza, collaborando attraverso funzioni per trasformare le opportunità in risultati misurabili e valore condiviso

A Nestlé, mettiamo le persone nel cuore di tutto quello che facciamo

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti dei dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione include tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che un forte elenco di candidati pertinenti è identificato, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto ad essere una Forza per il Bene?

Applicare ora e accelerare il cambiamento che migliora le vite e il pianeta.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que gestionnaire de compte clé

• Développer les comptes clés existants et nouveaux hors-domestique en traduisant les connaissances des clients, des canaux et du marché en possibilités de croissance adaptées

• Identifier et convertir de nouvelles occasions d'affaires dans des environnements de services alimentaires hors de la maison

• Établir des relations de confiance avec les clients, les exploitants et les distributeurs afin de co-créer des solutions culinaires, de café et de boissons qui répondent à leurs besoins opérationnels et commerciaux

• Mener des discussions commerciales consultatives et des revues d'entreprise qui renforcent la performance de la clientèle, la rentabilité et les partenariats à long terme

• Utiliser les réseaux de distributeurs et l'expertise cross-fonctionnel pour étendre la présence de Nestlé Professional.

• Agissant avec un esprit d'entreprise, prenant en main l'identification des opportunités par la mise en œuvre et des résultats commerciaux mesurables

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter une solide expérience de gestion de compte clé et de développement d'affaires dans le service alimentaire, HoReCa ou un autre environnement hors-domestique

• Comprendre l'écosystème hors du foyer, y compris le rôle des exploitants, des distributeurs et des différents canaux de services alimentaires, et utiliser ces idées pour identifier les possibilités de croissance

• Appliquer les capacités de vente, de planification commerciale et de négociation axées sur la consultation et la solution pour créer des propositions de clients sur mesure et une valeur durable

• Démontrer une forte mentalité de chasse et la capacité d'acquérir de nouveaux clients tout en développant des partenariats stratégiques à long terme

• Communiquer couramment en allemand et en français. L'anglais est un plus.

• Travailler avec autonomie, curiosité commerciale et résilience, tout en collaborant entre les fonctions pour transformer les possibilités en résultats mesurables et en valeur partagée

Chez Nestlé, on place les gens au cœur de tout ce qu'on fait

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Jours fériés payés au-delà des exigences légales

• Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour développer votre carrière

• Prime fondée sur les performances

• Contribution aux soins de santé et accès au Programme d'aide aux employés

• Une forte contribution de l'employeur à votre régime de retraite

• Congé parental généreux et solutions globales de soutien familial

• Réductions attrayantes pour les employés pour divers produits et services

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sécuritaire pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend généralement une entrevue avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents est établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de façon confidentielle.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé communiquera uniquement avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses électroniques officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à n'importe quelle étape du processus d'embauche.

Prêt à être une force pour le bien?

Appliquer maintenant et accélérer le changement qui améliore les vies et la planète.

jobs.description:

Work model: Full time
Contract type / duration: Temporary – maternity cover (6-12 months mission)

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further.

In this internal opportunity at Nestlé Suisse, your mission is to build and drive the MAGGI brand and portfolio strategy to rejuvenate the brand and double its size in the Swiss market. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with teams across marketing, sales, customer development, supply chain, finance, corporate communications, eCommerce, regional brand teams, and agency partners. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Brand Business Lead MAGGI

• Driving the MAGGI brand and portfolio strategy to accelerate growth, strengthen brand equity, and expand impact across the Swiss market.

• Identifying the most attractive consumer opportunities and turning insights into brand experiences that build relevance and long-term loyalty.

• Leading bold innovation and renovation initiatives that respond to consumer trends and create healthier, more compelling product experiences.

• Building integrated brand and communication plans that elevate visibility, sharpen positioning, and strengthen consistency across every touchpoint.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong brand strategy expertise and a clear understanding of how to grow brand performance, equity, and portfolio value.

• Using commercial and financial acumen to manage brand performance, optimise investments, and translate priorities into results.

• Collaborating effectively across functions and with external partners while leading, developing, and energising a high-performing team.

• Communicating with working proficiency in English and German or English and French.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Nestlé, we care about our people.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

Sei eine Kraft für das Gute und wachse durch Erfahrungen, die dich weiter bringen.

In dieser internen Gelegenheit bei Nestlé Suisse besteht Ihre Mission darin, die Marken- und Portfoliostrategie von MAGGI aufzubauen und voranzutreiben, um die Marke zu verjüngen und ihre Größe auf dem Schweizer Markt zu verdoppeln. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit Teams aus den Bereichen Marketing, Vertrieb, Kundenentwicklung, Supply Chain, Finanzen, Unternehmenskommunikation, E-Commerce, regionale Markenteams und Agenturpartner zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Eigenverantwortung zu übernehmen, Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und einen großen Unterschied zu machen.

Wie Sie als Brand Business Lead MAGGI etwas bewirken

• Die MAGGI Marken- und Portfoliostrategie vorantreiben, um das Wachstum zu beschleunigen, den Markenwert zu stärken und den Einfluss auf den Schweizer Markt zu erweitern.

• Identifizierung der attraktivsten Verbraucherchancen und Umsetzung von Erkenntnissen in Markenerlebnisse, die Relevanz und langfristige Loyalität aufbauen.

• Führen Sie mutige Innovations- und Renovierungsinitiativen, die auf Verbrauchertrends reagieren und gesündere, überzeugendere Produkterlebnisse schaffen.

• Aufbau integrierter Marken- und Kommunikationspläne, die die Sichtbarkeit erhöhen, die Positionierung schärfen und die Konsistenz über jeden Touchpoint hinweg stärken.

• Managen der Markenperformance mit einer starken kommerziellen Denkweise, wobei Investitionen priorisiert werden, um Wert, Rentabilität und Kanaleffektivität zu maximieren.

• Als Line Manager und Mitglied des Swiss Food Leadership Teams, leitet und entwickelt er direkt ein Team von 3 Personen und treibt die gesamte Food Switzerland Strategie mit Schnelligkeit, Klarheit und gemeinsamer Verantwortung für Geschäftsergebnisse voran.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Bringen Sie starke Markenstrategie-Know-how und ein klares Verständnis davon, wie Sie Markenleistung, Aktien und Portfoliowert steigern können.

• Anwendung von Verbraucher- und Markteinblicken zur Gestaltung effektiver Innovations-, Renovierungs- und Aktivierungsstrategien.

• Nutzung von kommerziellem und finanziellem Scharfsinn, um die Markenleistung zu verwalten, Investitionen zu optimieren und Prioritäten in Ergebnisse umzusetzen.

• Effektive Zusammenarbeit über Funktionen hinweg und mit externen Partnern hinweg, während ein leistungsstarkes Team geleitet, entwickelt und unterstützt wird.

• Kommunikation mit Arbeitskenntnissen in Englisch und Deutsch oder Englisch und Französisch.

• Demonstrieren Sie Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen.

Bei Nestlé kümmern wir uns um unsere Leute.

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Flexible Arbeitsoptionen, einschließlich hybrider Arbeitsmöglichkeiten (für Office-basierte Rollen)

• Bezahlter Urlaub über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere zu erweitern

• Leistungsbasierter Bonus

• Gesundheitsbeitrag und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Starker Arbeitgeberbeitrag zu Ihrem Pensionsplan

• Großzügiger Elternurlaub und umfassende Familienunterstützungslösungen

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Videointerview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bereit, mit uns zu wachsen?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und wachsen Sie durch Erfahrungen, die Sie weiter vorantreiben.

jobs.title: Regional Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
Lieu : Est de la Suisse romande — cantons de Vaud, Fribourg et Valais

Taux d’activité : Temps plein, 100%

Type de Contract : Contrat à durée indéterminée

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Chez Nestlé Professional , nous accompagnons les professionnels de la restauration avec des solutions café et culinaires de premier plan, permettant aux amateurs de gastronomie à travers toute la Suisse de profiter de produits de haute qualité grâce à des marques emblématiques telles que STARBUCKS®, NESCAFÉ®, THOMY®, MAGGI®, CAILLER® et CHEF® .

En tant que Regional Key Account Manager Food & Beverages , vous rejoignez une équipe expérimentée et engagée. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de comptes stratégiques sur l'Est de la Suisse romande, en identifiant de nouvelles opportunités commerciales, en élaborant des stratégies de croissance et en créant des partenariats durables avec vos clients.

Véritable partenaire de confiance, vous serez l'interlocuteur privilégié de vos clients et contribuerez activement au développement de votre portefeuille en conciliant acquisition de nouveaux comptes, fidélisation des clients existants et atteinte durable des objectifs commerciaux.

Votre impact en tant que Regional Key Account Manager Food & Beverages

• Développer et entretenir des relations partenariales solides avec les clients, en agissant comme interlocuteur privilégié et en garantissant leur satisfaction à long terme.

• Identifier et concrétiser les opportunités d’acquisition de nouveaux clients, en élaborant des offres Food & Beverages adaptées à leurs besoins.

• Piloter les négociations contractuelles jusqu’à la conclusion des accords, en assurant l’atteinte des objectifs commerciaux.

• Décliner et mettre en œuvre la stratégie de vente nationale au niveau régional, en l’adaptant au contexte local et aux spécificités des clients clés.

• Suivre, analyser et piloter la performance des clients à l’aide d’indicateurs clés, et définir des plans d’action structurés afin d’atteindre, voire dépasser, les objectifs fixés.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les différentes équipes internes.

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• Expérience réussie dans la vente au sein du secteur HORECA, idéalement dans les domaines du café, des boissons ou des produits culinaires.

• Excellent sens de la négociation et forte orientation résultats.

• Maîtrise du français et de l’allemand indispensable; l’anglais constitue un atout.

• Autonomie, esprit d’initiative, flexibilité et forte orientation client.

Chez Nestlé Professional, les personnes sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nous mettons tout en œuvre pour offrir un environnement de travail qui favorise votre développement professionnel, votre bien-être et votre équilibre de vie:

• Des modalités de travail flexibles adaptées aux exigences du poste.

• Des congés supérieurs aux dispositions légales.

• De nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement professionnel.

• Un système de rémunération variable lié à la performance.

• Une participation aux frais de santé ainsi qu'un programme d'assistance aux collaborateurs.

• Une contribution attractive à votre prévoyance professionnelle.

• Des congés parentaux généreux et des solutions de soutien aux familles.

• Des réductions avantageuses sur une large gamme de produits et services.

Vous évoluerez au sein d'un environnement inclusif et stimulant, offrant de nombreuses opportunités de développement et de collaboration à travers les différentes activités de Nestlé.

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

At Nestlé Professional, we support catering professionals with leading coffee and culinary solutions, allowing food lovers throughout Switzerland to enjoy high quality products thanks to iconic brands such as STARBUCKS®, NESCAFÉ®, THOMY®, MAGGI®, CAILLER® and CHEF®.

As a trusted partner, you will be the preferred partner for your customers and will actively contribute to the development of your portfolio by reconciling acquisition of new accounts, retention of existing customers and sustainable achievement of business goals.

Your Impact as Regional Key Account Manager Food & Beverages

• Develop and maintain strong partnership relationships with clients, acting as the preferred interlocutor and ensuring their long-term satisfaction.

• Identify and realize opportunities to acquire new customers by developing Food & Beverages offers tailored to their needs.

• Pilot contractual negotiations until agreements are concluded, ensuring the achievement of trade objectives.

What Will Make Your Success

• Successful experience in selling in the HORECA sector, ideally in the areas of coffee, drinks or culinary products.

• Excellent bargaining sense and strong direction results.

• Mastery of French and German; English is an asset.

• Autonomy, initiative, flexibility and strong customer orientation.

At Nestlé Professional, people are at the heart of everything we do.

• Flexible working arrangements adapted to the requirements of the position.

• Holidays exceeding the legal provisions.

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

As an R&D Packaging Development Intern at Nestlé Product Technology Centre (NPTC), your mission is to support the renovation of the Nescafé Dolce Gusto capsule body and contribute to the industrialization of the NEO SACHET 2030 project. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with packaging, quality assurance and system performance teams, as well as packaging material suppliers and external partners. This is your opportunity to gain hands-on experience in packaging innovation while working on a strategic sustainability and industrialization project.

How you’ll make an impact as an R&D Packaging Development Intern

• Support the renovation of the Nescafé Dolce Gusto capsule body by contributing to packaging material evaluation, testing and documentation

• Contribute to the industrialization of the NEO SACHET 2030 project through laboratory work, pilot trials and supplier or factory testing activities

• Collaborate with packaging, quality assurance and system performance teams to ensure packaging solutions meet technical, quality and sustainability expectations

• Prepare clear presentations, test reports and technical summaries to support project decisions and stakeholder alignment

• Interact with packaging material suppliers and external partners to follow up on trials, results and next steps in an agile project environment

What will make you successful

• Fresh graduate or current student in Materials Science, Packaging, Mechanical Engineering or a related field

• Interest in packaging development, sustainable materials, industrialization and hands-on testing in an R&D environment

• Good communication skills, attention to detail, curiosity and the ability to work proactively with cross-functional teams

• Strong data analytics skills, with the ability to interpret test results and translate data into clear insights. Previous experience on SPSS software is a plus

• Solid command of the MS Office Suite, especially Excel for data analysis

• Fluency in English; knowledge of French is an advantage

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. This is your opportunity to gain hands-on experience in packaging innovation while working on a strategic sustainability and industrialization project.

How you’ll make an impact as an R&D Packaging Development Intern

• Support the renovation of the Nescafé Dolce Gusto capsule body by contributing to packaging material evaluation, testing and documentation

• Contribute to the industrialization of the NEO SACHET 2030 project through laboratory work, pilot trials and supplier or factory testing activities

• Collaborate with packaging, quality assurance and system performance teams to ensure packaging solutions meet technical, quality and sustainability expectations

• Prepare clear presentations, test reports and technical summaries to support project decisions and stakeholder alignment

• Interact with packaging material suppliers and external partners to follow up on trials, results and next steps in an agile project environment

What will make you successful

• Fresh graduate or current student in Materials Science, Packaging, Mechanical Engineering or a related field

• Interest in packaging development, sustainable materials, industrialization and hands-on testing in an R&D environment

• Good communication skills, attention to detail, curiosity and the ability to work proactively with cross-functional teams

• Strong data analytics skills, with the ability to interpret test results and translate data into clear insights. Previous experience on SPSS software is a plus

• Solid command of the MS Office Suite, especially Excel for data analysis

• Fluency in English; knowledge of French is an advantage

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

jobs.title: SPX Data & AI Innovation Intern
jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type / duration: Internship – 6 months

Start date: January / February 2027
Deadline for applications: 14 October 2026

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

As an SPX Data & AI Innovation Intern at Nestlé Research & Development, your mission is to support building the future SPX knowledge ecosystem through dashboards, connected data and Artificial Intelligence. You will support the Sensory & Product Experience (SPX) Digital & AI roadmap by improving data accessibility, developing innovative digital solutions, and accelerating insight generation across product innovation projects.

Working closely with Sensory & Product Experience experts, data engineers and innovation teams, you will help transform complex datasets into actionable knowledge while gaining hands-on experience at the intersection of sensory science, consumer understanding, data science, and AI.

How you’ll make an impact as a SPX Data & AI Innovation Intern

• Develop and enhance SPX Dashboards to improve visibility, accessibility, and use of sensory and consumer data across teams.

• Connect and explore multiple data sources, including Methods of Preparation (MOP), Key Sensory Attributes (KSA), Sensory Profiles, Claims, Global Sensory Mapping (GSM), Consumer Research, and Market Insights.

• Create impactful data visualizations and translate complex data into meaningful business insights.

• Support the development of AI-powered solutions and knowledge systems that improve information retrieval and insight generation.

• Collaborate with sensory scientists, consumer insight experts, and digital specialists to accelerate product renovation and innovation.

What will make you successful

• Bachelor’s or Master’s student, or recent graduate, in Data Science, Statistics, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Food Science, or a related field

• Strong interest in data, digital technologies, consumer experience, sensory and product innovation

• Comfortable working with data and translating complex information into meaningful insights

• Academic or previous work experience with Power BI or similar visualization tools, and Version Control Sytems (like Github)

• Programming skills in Python or R

• Experience with AI-enabled tools, knowledge systems, or data exploration platforms is an advantage

• Strong analytical thinking, curiosity, collaboration, and communication skills

• Fluency in English (written and spoken)

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to start your career journey with us?

Apply now and transform your potential into something extraordinary.

Als SPX Data & AI Innovation Intern bei Nestlé Research & Development ist es Ihre Mission, den Aufbau des zukünftigen SPX-Wissens-Ökosystems durch Dashboards, vernetzte Daten und künstliche Intelligenz zu unterstützen. Sie unterstützen die Digital & AI Roadmap von Sensory & Product Experience (SPX), indem Sie die Zugänglichkeit von Daten verbessern, innovative digitale Lösungen entwickeln und die Generierung von Erkenntnissen in Produktinnovationsprojekten beschleunigen.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Experten für Sensory & Product Experience, Dateningenieuren und Innovationsteams helfen Sie dabei, komplexe Datensätze in umsetzbares Wissen zu verwandeln und gleichzeitig praktische Erfahrungen an der Schnittstelle von Sensorik, Verbraucherverständnis, Datenwissenschaft und KI zu sammeln.

Wie Sie als SPX Data & AI Innovation Intern etwas bewirken können

• Entwickeln und verbessern Sie SPX Dashboards, um die Sichtbarkeit, Zugänglichkeit und Nutzung von Sensorik- und Verbraucherdaten teamübergreifend zu verbessern.

• Verbinden und erkunden Sie mehrere Datenquellen, einschließlich Methoden der Vorbereitung (MOP), Key Sensory Attributes (KSA), Sensory Profiles, Claims, Global Sensory Mapping (GSM), Consumer Research und Market Insights.

• Unterstützung der Entwicklung von KI-gestützten Lösungen und Wissenssystemen, die den Informationsabruf und die Generierung von Erkenntnissen verbessern.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Sensorikern, Experten für Verbraucherinformationen und digitalen Spezialisten zusammen, um die Produktrenovierung und -innovation zu beschleunigen.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Bachelor- oder Master-Student oder neuer Absolvent, in Data Science, Statistik, Künstliche Intelligenz, Informatik, Food Science oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Starkes Interesse an Daten, digitalen Technologien, Verbrauchererfahrung, sensorischen und Produktinnovationen

• Komfortables Arbeiten mit Daten und Umsetzung komplexer Informationen in sinnvolle Erkenntnisse

• Fließend in Englisch (geschrieben und gesprochen)

• Demonstrieren Sie Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen, während Sie Ideen in messbare Auswirkungen übersetzen und gemeinsame Werte schaffen.

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type: Permanent

Travel Rate: 100% (Around 90% factory-based and 10% HQ-based)

Programme: 4-year development programme with 5–6-month international factory assignments across Nestlé’s global Operations network

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Performance Acceleration Senior Analyst at Nestlé Operations, you will join a unique 4-year development programme, completing international assignments of 5-6 months in Nestlé factories around the world. Your mission will be to accelerate operational performance and drive sustainable improvements across our global manufacturing network. You'll make a difference by collaborating closely with local factory teams, R&D experts, and corporate stakeholders.

With extensive international travel and hands-on exposure to complex manufacturing operations, this is your opportunity to grow your career, work across diverse cultures and production environments, and build a strong network within Nestlé's global Operations community.

How you’ll make an impact as a Performance Acceleration Senior Analyst

• Driving continuous improvement initiatives that enhance performance, productivity, and competitiveness across factories worldwide.

• Leading operational optimization and digital transformation projects that deliver measurable and sustainable results.

• Collaborating with factory leadership teams, technical experts, and global stakeholders to accelerate implementation and value creation.

• Coaching teams and supporting capability building to embed best practices and sustain long-term improvements.

• Managing cross-functional projects while leveraging Nestlé's global network to share knowledge, benchmark performance, and accelerate innovation.

• Strengthening operational excellence capabilities by promoting manufacturing standards and continuous learning across markets.

What will make you successful

• Bringing experience in a factory environment, such as production, quality, engineering, or related manufacturing functions. Previous line management experience is a plus.

• Applying strong project leadership and problem-solving skills to deliver meaningful business improvements.

• Using coaching and influencing capabilities to engage, develop, and support diverse teams.

• Embracing a highly international role that combines extensive travel, long-term factory assignments, and collaboration with diverse teams across different cultures and markets.

• Communicating fluently in English; additional language skills are an advantage.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Come farete un impatto come analista senior di accelerazione delle prestazioni

• Guidare iniziative di miglioramento continuo che migliorano le prestazioni, la produttività e la competitività nelle fabbriche in tutto il mondo.

• I principali progetti di ottimizzazione operativa e trasformazione digitale che offrono risultati misurabili e sostenibili.

• Collaborare con team di leadership di fabbrica, esperti tecnici e stakeholder globali per accelerare l'implementazione e la creazione di valore.

• Squadre di coaching e capacità di supporto per incorporare le migliori pratiche e sostenere i miglioramenti a lungo termine.

• Gestione di progetti interfunzionali, sfruttando la rete globale di Nestlé per condividere conoscenze, prestazioni di benchmark e accelerare l'innovazione.

• Rafforzare le capacità di eccellenza operativa promuovendo gli standard di produzione e l'apprendimento continuo sui mercati.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare esperienza in un ambiente di fabbrica, come la produzione, la qualità, l'ingegneria o le funzioni di produzione correlate. Precedente esperienza di gestione della linea è un vantaggio.

• Applicare una forte leadership di progetto e capacità di problem solving per fornire miglioramenti significativi di business.

• Utilizzando le capacità di coaching e influenzando le capacità di coinvolgere, sviluppare e supportare diverse squadre.

• Abbracciando un ruolo altamente internazionale che combina viaggi estensivi, incarichi di fabbrica a lungo termine, e la collaborazione con diverse squadre in diverse culture e mercati.

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese; competenze linguistiche aggiuntive sono un vantaggio.

• Dimostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo.

A Nestlé, mettiamo le persone nel cuore di tutto quello che facciamo.

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Sconti interessanti dei dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Il processo di assunzione include tipicamente un'intervista video con Talent Acquisition, una valutazione, un'intervista con il team di assunzione e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che un forte elenco di candidati pertinenti è identificato, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto ad essere una forza per il bene?

Applicare ora e accelerare il cambiamento che migliora le vite e il pianeta.

Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type / duration: Permanent contract

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Corporate Insurance Specialist – Non-Life & Insured Benefits at Nestlé, your mission is to support the effective renewal and administration of global insurance programs that protect our people, operations and assets. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with Group Risk Services colleagues, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, markets, insurance brokers and insurers. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and deliver meaningful results that make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Corporate Insurance Specialist – Non-Life & Insured Benefits

• Supporting timely, accurate renewals of global non-life and insured employee benefits programs.

• Coordinating insurance data, submissions and documentation to strengthen coverage decisions across markets.

• Ensuring policies, endorsements, premium allocations and payments are accurate and completed on time.

• Managing smaller insurance programs from renewal administration through payment and claims follow-up.

• Contributing to fair, effective selection processes for global and local insurers and brokers.

• Building trusted relationships that improve service quality and support consistent insurance delivery worldwide.

What will make you successful

• Bringing practical knowledge of insurance gained with an insurer, broker or corporate risk management team.

• Applying strong attention to detail across renewals, data collection, policy reviews, premium allocation and record keeping.

• Using sound knowledge of non-life insurance and insured employee benefits to support global programs confidently.

• Collaborating effectively across teams while building productive relationships with insurers, brokers and internal partners.

• Communicating fluently in English; French and German are an advantage.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

• Utilizzando una solida conoscenza dell'assicurazione non vita e delle prestazioni dei dipendenti assicurati per sostenere i programmi globali con fiducia.

jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland, with regular travel to Orbe and other Nestlé R&D sites
Work model: Full-time, 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent
Closing Date for Applications: 15th September 2026

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As a Patent Counsel in Digital & AI, your mission is to enable and protect Nestlé’s digital, AI-driven and electronics-centric innovations through pragmatic legal services and business-driven IP protection. You will act as the go-to Legal R&D partner for Digital & AI topics across the Nestlé R&D ecosystem, collaborating closely with R&D teams, Patent Counsels, R&D Counsels and IP Analysts. This is your opportunity to shape and grow the IP strategy for one of Nestlé’s most strategic innovation frontiers.

How you’ll make an impact as a Patent Counsel – Digital & AI

• Develop and deliver the IP strategy for digital, AI and electronics-driven innovations, in close partnership with R&D teams, the patent team, R&D Counsels and IP Analysts.

• Lead business-driven patent filing and prosecution, Freedom-to-Operate assessments, oppositions of third-party patents and defense against third-party oppositions.

• Manage your patent portfolio with strong business alignment and rigorous cost management.

• Advise on IP matters in R&D collaborations, including Digital & AI partnerships, licensing and joint developments.

• Support Coffee & Systems and other categories on connected systems, digital platforms and AI-based innovations, in collaboration with category Patent Counsels.

• Partner with Nestlé Research, the Nestlé Deep Tech Center, NPTC – Nestlé Professional and other R&D centers to protect digital and AI innovations across categories.

• Promote passion for IP through awareness sessions, training and communication, while contributing to the awareness and enforcement of Nestlé patents in R&D and in the markets.

What will make you successful

• Fully qualified patent attorney, European Patent Attorney (EQE) and/or national qualification in a major jurisdiction such as the USA, with a background in Electronics, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, AI or a related engineering discipline.

• Proven experience in digital, AI and/or electronics-related IP projects, ideally including software-implemented inventions, AI/ML, connected devices and computer-implemented business methods.

• More than 3 years of post-qualification experience with patent drafting, prosecution and Freedom-to-Operate assessments in the digital, electronics or AI space.

• Experience developing business-driven IP strategies across multiple jurisdictions, with a solid understanding of software and AI patenting specificities such as EPO, USPTO and CNIPA.

• Service-oriented, pragmatic, rigorous, hands-on and collaborative, with the ability to engage confidently with R&D partners, category teams and stakeholders at different levels of seniority.

• Fluent in English; French is a plus.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Nestlé, we care about our people

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Exciting opportunities to develop your career your way, across different brands, businesses, functions, and regions.

• Flexible working arrangements that facilitate creativity and collaboration.

• A culture of respect, with diversity, equity, and inclusion at its core.

• A dynamic international environment empowering you to learn, develop, and grow.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and help shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live healthier lives, and deliver impact at a scale and pace that makes a difference.

• Promuovere la passione per l'IP attraverso sessioni di sensibilizzazione, formazione e comunicazione, contribuendo alla consapevolezza e all'applicazione dei brevetti Nestlé in R&D e nei mercati.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Procuratore di brevetti completamente qualificato, Avvocato europeo dei brevetti (EQE) e / o qualifica nazionale in una giurisdizione principale come gli Stati Uniti, con un background in Elettronica, Scienza informatica, Ingegneria del software, Scienza dei dati, AI o una disciplina di ingegneria correlata.

• Esperienza dimostrata nei progetti IP digitali, AI e/o relativi all'elettronica, idealmente compresi invenzioni implementate dal software, AI/ML, dispositivi connessi e metodi di business implementati dal computer.

• Più di 3 anni di esperienza post-qualificazione con la redazione di brevetti, la prosecuzione e le valutazioni Freedom-to-Operate nello spazio digitale, elettronico o AI.

• Sperimenta lo sviluppo di strategie IP business-driven in più giurisdizioni, con una solida comprensione del software e delle specifiche di brevetti AI come EPO, USPTO e CNIPA.

• Service-oriented, pragmatico, rigoroso, pratico e collaborativo, con la capacità di impegnarsi con fiducia con partner R&D, team di categoria e stakeholder a diversi livelli di seniority.

• Fluente in inglese; francese è un plus.

• Dimostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo.

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Disposizioni di lavoro flessibili che facilitano la creatività e la collaborazione.

• Una cultura del rispetto, con diversità, equità e inclusione nel suo nucleo.

• Un ambiente dinamico internazionale che ti consente di imparare, sviluppare e crescere.

Sei eine Kraft für das Gute und wachse durch Erfahrungen, die dich weiter bringen

Als Patentberater für Digital & AI ist es Ihre Mission, die digitalen, KI-gesteuerten und elektronikzentrierten Innovationen von Nestlé durch pragmatische Rechtsdienstleistungen und geschäftsorientierten IP-Schutz zu ermöglichen und zu schützen.
