Dies ist Ihre Chance, die IP-Strategie für eine der strategischsten Innovationsgrenzen von Nestlé zu gestalten und auszubauen.

Wie Sie als Patent Counsel etwas bewirken – Digital & AI

• Entwickeln und liefern Sie die IP-Strategie für digitale, KI- und Elektronik-getriebene Innovationen in enger Partnerschaft mit R & D-Teams, dem Patentteam, R & D Counsels und IP Analysten.

• Führen Sie geschäftsorientierte Patentanmeldungen und -verfolgung, Freedom-to-Operate-Bewertungen, Einsprüche von Patenten Dritter und Verteidigung gegen Einsprüche Dritter.

• Beratung in IP-Fragen in F&E-Kooperationen, einschließlich Digital & AI-Partnerschaften, Lizenzierung und gemeinsamen Entwicklungen.

• Unterstützung von Coffee & Systems und anderen Kategorien für vernetzte Systeme, digitale Plattformen und KI-basierte Innovationen in Zusammenarbeit mit der Kategorie Patent Counsels.

• Partnerschaft mit Nestlé Research, dem Nestlé Deep Tech Center, NPTC – Nestlé Professional und anderen F&E-Zentren zum Schutz digitaler und KI-Innovationen in allen Kategorien.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Vollständig qualifizierter Patentanwalt, Europäischer Patentanwalt (EQE) und / oder nationale Qualifikation in einer wichtigen Gerichtsbarkeit wie den USA, mit einem Hintergrund in Elektronik, Informatik, Software Engineering, Data Science, KI oder einer verwandten Ingenieurdisziplin.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in digitalen, KI- und / oder Elektronik-bezogenen IP-Projekten, idealerweise einschließlich softwareimplementierter Erfindungen, AI / ML, verbundener Geräte und computerimplementierter Geschäftsmethoden.

• Mehr als 3 Jahre Erfahrung nach der Qualifikation mit Patententwürfen, Strafverfolgung und Freedom-to-Operate-Bewertungen im digitalen, elektronischen oder KI-Bereich.

• Erleben Sie die Entwicklung unternehmensorientierter IP-Strategien in mehreren Jurisdiktionen mit einem soliden Verständnis von Software- und KI-Patentierungsspezifitäten wie EPO, USPTO und CNIPA.

• Serviceorientiert, pragmatisch, rigoros, praxisnah und kooperativ, mit der Fähigkeit, vertrauensvoll mit F & E-Partnern, Kategorieteams und Stakeholdern auf verschiedenen Ebenen der Seniorität zu interagieren.

• Fließend in englisch; französisch ist ein plus.

• Demonstrieren Sie Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen.

Bei Nestlé kümmern wir uns um unsere Mitarbeiter

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Spannende Möglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere auf Ihre Weise zu entwickeln, über verschiedene Marken, Unternehmen, Funktionen und Regionen hinweg.

• Flexible Arbeitsvereinbarungen, die Kreativität und Zusammenarbeit erleichtern.

• Eine Kultur des Respekts, mit Vielfalt, Gerechtigkeit und Inklusion im Mittelpunkt.

• Ein dynamisches internationales Umfeld, in dem Sie lernen, sich entwickeln und wachsen können.

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird Kandidaten nur über offizielle Firmen-E-Mail-Adressen kontaktieren und wird zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Einstellungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

Bereit, mit uns zu wachsen?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und tragen Sie dazu bei, eine bessere und gesündere Welt zu gestalten, Menschen zu einem gesünderen Leben zu inspirieren und Auswirkungen in einem Umfang und Tempo zu erzielen, die einen Unterschied machen.

• Démontrer courage, collaboration, rapidité et apprentissage continu.

• Des occasions passionnantes de développer votre carrière à votre manière, entre différentes marques, entreprises, fonctions et régions.

Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. jobs.description:
Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based / Full time
Contract type / duration: Fixed-term contract (2 years)

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Bioprocess Engineer - Pilot Plant (Fermentation & DSP) at Nestlé Research, your mission is to lead bioprocessing activities that bridge lab-scale discovery and industrial manufacturing through robust fermentation and downstream processing solutions. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with pilot plant teams, scientists, engineers, quality and safety specialists, technical experts and external partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Bioprocess Engineer - Pilot Plant (DSP)

• Leading pilot-scale bioprocess trials that help transform promising research into scalable manufacturing solutions.

• Driving fermentation process development by optimizing media, feeding strategies and key operating parameters for reliable performance.

• Developing downstream processing approaches that improve yield, recovery and product quality.

• Building process understanding through data analysis, automation insights and digital tools that support optimization and reproducibility.

• Contributing to safe, compliant and high-quality pilot plant operations through risk assessment, documentation and continuous improvement.

• Shaping the development of new biotech pilot plant capabilities by translating process needs into practical equipment and facility solutions.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in fermentation, bioprocessing and pilot or industrial-scale operations.

• Applying scale-up, technology transfer and industrialization knowledge to make processes robust and ready for implementation.

• Using analytical thinking, process data and automation tools to troubleshoot, optimize and improve reproducibility.

• Collaborating across research, engineering, operations, quality and safety teams with ownership and a hands-on mindset.

• Communicating confidently and delivering presentations in French or English.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to #BreakthroughTogether?

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

#nestlecareerswitzerland

Dies ist Ihre Chance, Ideen in nachhaltige und innovative Lösungen für Menschen, Haustiere und den Planeten zu verwandeln.

Wie Sie als Bioprocess Engineer - Pilot Plant (DSP) etwas bewirken

Façonner l'avenir par des percées scientifiques et l'innovation.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter une solide expertise dans la fermentation, le biotraitement et les opérations pilotes ou industrielles.

• Appliquer l'échelle, le transfert de technologie et les connaissances en matière d'industrialisation pour rendre les processus robustes et prêts à être mis en œuvre.

jobs.description:
HR Business Partner Operations – Nestlé Waters (Suisse) SA

Location: Henniez, Switzerland
Work model: Office-based with hybrid flexibility / 80%-100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

As a HR Business Partner Operations at Nestlé Waters, your mission is to co-pilot the people agenda for operations, manufacturing and supply chain while shaping a strong apprenticeship experience. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with people managers, employee representatives, apprentices, trainers and cross-functional teams. This is your opportunity to unlock the future of beverages and craft experiences that elevate everyday living.

How you’ll make an impact as a HR Business Partner Operations

• Driving people strategies and workforce planning that enable strong operational performance across manufacturing and supply chain.

• Shaping effective organization design and supporting smooth transitions that help teams adapt, grow and deliver.

• Building inclusive talent and performance practices that strengthen engagement, development and team effectiveness.

• Partnering with employee representatives to foster constructive relationships, trust and a fair working environment.

• Developing apprenticeship and trainee pathways that prepare future talent and support high-quality learning experiences.

• Leading people projects and compliance activities that support safe, efficient and sustainable operations.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong knowledge of people processes, with a focus on workforce planning, talent development, organization design and compensation.

• Applying sound understanding of Swiss labour law and employment practices to guide confident, compliant decisions.

• Using collaboration, learning agility, courage and speed to coach managers and support teams through change.

• Collaborating with empathy, resilience and adaptability to build trusted relationships across different stakeholder styles.

• Communicating fluently in French, German and English.

At Nestlé Waters, we place people at the heart of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and service

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As an Associate Specialist Functional Microbiome at Nestlé Research, your mission is to advance research on microbial metabolites and translate functional microbiome science into meaningful business applications. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with scientists, technicians, research assistants, innovation partners and external experts across microbiome, metabolomics, immunology and related fields. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as an Associate Specialist Functional Microbiome

• Developing research that deepens understanding of microbial metabolites and their role in microbiome-host interactions.

• Translating scientific insights into nutrition, health and petcare applications with business relevance.

• Strengthening scientific approaches that move microbiome research from correlations toward causal understanding.

• Building cross-functional collaboration with internal research teams, technical experts and innovation partners.

• Expanding external scientific networks to identify emerging methods, partners and breakthrough opportunities.

• Using project leadership, stakeholder management and results focus to deliver high-quality research outcomes.

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

Come Microbiome Funzionale Associate Specialist presso Nestlé Research, la vostra missione è quella di promuovere la ricerca sui metaboliti microbici e tradurre la scienza microbioma funzionale in applicazioni aziendali significative. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con scienziati, tecnici, assistenti di ricerca, partner di innovazione e esperti esterni attraverso microbiome, metabolomics, immunologia e campi correlati. Questa è la vostra occasione per trasformare le idee in soluzioni sostenibili e innovative per persone, animali domestici e il pianeta.

Come farete un impatto come Microbiome Funzionale Associate Specialist

• Sviluppare ricerche che approfondiscono la comprensione dei metaboliti microbici e il loro ruolo nelle interazioni microbiome-host.

• Tradurre intuizioni scientifiche in materia di nutrizione, salute e applicazioni di petcare con rilevanza aziendale.

• Rafforzare gli approcci scientifici che spostano la ricerca del microbioma dalle correlazioni verso la comprensione causale.

• Costruire collaborazioni interfunzionali con team di ricerca interni, esperti tecnici e partner di innovazione.

• Ampliamento di reti scientifiche esterne per identificare metodi emergenti, partner e opportunità innovative.

• Condivisione di output scientifici di alta qualità attraverso pubblicazioni, presentazioni e comunicazione chiara con i principali stakeholder.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare un dottorato e riconosciuta esperienza scientifica in biochimica, microbiologia o metabolismo, con una forte attenzione ai metaboliti microbici nelle interazioni microbiome-host.

• Applicare sistemi di biologia, metabolomica e conoscenze microbiome funzionali per generare approfondimenti di ricerca attuabili.

• Utilizzando la leadership del progetto, la gestione degli stakeholder e i risultati si concentrano per fornire risultati di ricerca di alta qualità.

• Collaborare attivamente attraverso le discipline scientifiche, comunicando idee complesse con chiarezza e influenza.

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese.

• Portare la collaborazione, il pensiero fresco, domande audaci, il rispetto e una mentalità positiva e orientata al benessere.

A seconda del ruolo, può essere inclusa una valutazione video. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Gestalten Sie die Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen.

Als Associate Specialist Functional Microbiome bei Nestlé Research ist es Ihre Mission, die Forschung zu mikrobiellen Metaboliten voranzutreiben und die funktionelle Mikrobiomwissenschaft in sinnvolle Geschäftsanwendungen zu übersetzen. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit Wissenschaftlern, Technikern, Forschungsassistenten, Innovationspartnern und externen Experten aus den Bereichen Mikrobiom, Metabolomik, Immunologie und verwandten Bereichen zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Ideen in nachhaltige und innovative Lösungen für Menschen, Haustiere und den Planeten zu verwandeln.

Wie Sie als Associate Specialist Functional Microbiome eine Wirkung erzielen

• Entwicklung von Forschungen, die das Verständnis mikrobieller Metaboliten und ihrer Rolle bei Mikrobiom-Wirt-Interaktionen vertiefen.

• Übersetzen wissenschaftlicher Erkenntnisse in Anwendungen für Ernährung, Gesundheit und Tierpflege mit geschäftlicher Relevanz.

• Stärkung wissenschaftlicher Ansätze, die die Mikrobiomforschung von Korrelationen zu kausalem Verständnis bewegen.

• Aufbau einer funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit mit internen Forschungsteams, technischen Experten und Innovationspartnern.

• Ausbau externer wissenschaftlicher Netzwerke zur Identifizierung neuer Methoden, Partner und bahnbrechender Möglichkeiten.

• Austausch hochwertiger wissenschaftlicher Ergebnisse durch Veröffentlichungen, Präsentationen und eine klare Kommunikation mit den wichtigsten Interessengruppen.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Ein PhD und anerkannte wissenschaftliche Expertise in Biochemie, Mikrobiologie oder Stoffwechsel, mit einem starken Fokus auf mikrobielle Metaboliten in Mikrobiom-Wirt-Interaktionen.

• Anwendung von Systembiologie, Metabolomik und funktionellem Mikrobiomwissen, um umsetzbare Forschungserkenntnisse zu generieren.

• Mithilfe der Projektleitung konzentrieren sich das Stakeholder-Management und die Ergebnisse darauf, qualitativ hochwertige Forschungsergebnisse zu liefern.

• Proaktive Zusammenarbeit zwischen wissenschaftlichen Disziplinen und gleichzeitige Kommunikation komplexer Ideen mit Klarheit und Einfluss.

• fließend auf Englisch kommunizieren.

• Bringt Zusammenarbeit, frisches Denken, mutige Fragen, Respekt und eine positive, auf Wohlbefinden ausgerichtete Denkweise.

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren unterstützt, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Interview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Abhängig von der Rolle kann eine Videobewertung enthalten sein. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Façonner l'avenir par des percées scientifiques et l'innovation.

• Développer des recherches qui approfondissent la compréhension des métabolites microbiens et de leur rôle dans les interactions microbiome-hôte.

• Apporter un doctorat et une expertise scientifique reconnue en biochimie, microbiologie ou métabolisme, en mettant fortement l'accent sur les métabolites microbiens dans les interactions microbiome-hôte.

• Appliquer la biologie des systèmes, la métabolomique et les connaissances fonctionnelles en microbiome pour générer des idées de recherche exploitables.

• Utiliser le leadership du projet, la gestion des intervenants et l'accent sur les résultats pour obtenir des résultats de recherche de grande qualité.

• Collaborer de façon proactive entre les disciplines scientifiques tout en communiquant des idées complexes avec clarté et influence.

• Communiquer couramment en anglais.

• Apporter la collaboration, la pensée nouvelle, les questions audacieuses, le respect et un état d'esprit positif et axé sur le bien-être.

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Selon le rôle, une évaluation vidéo peut être incluse. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents a été établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

jobs.title: Machine Quality Senior Specialist
jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Target start date: As soon as possible

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As Machine Quality Senior Specialist at Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee & Beverages , your mission is to build trust and deliver outstanding consumer experiences by embedding food safety, compliance and quality into beverage systems of both Nespresso and Nestlé Dolce Gusto from the earliest design stages. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with project managers, category teams, factories, regulatory and legal partners, consumer services and suppliers. This is your opportunity to drive cutting-edge innovation, strengthen your expertise and deliver meaningful results to create unique consumer experiences at global scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Machine Quality Senior Specialist

• Safeguarding food safety, regulatory compliance and consumer expectations throughout beverage-system development.

• Embedding quality by design across new products, packaging, machines and production lines to improve right-first-time delivery.

• Driving robust validation plans, quality requirements and process capability from ideation through technical approval and launch.

• Anticipating quality risks through root-cause analysis, risk assessment and failure mode analysis, enabling pragmatic decisions.

• Resolving quality issues with factories and consumer service teams and ensuring corrective actions strengthen future developments.

• Building quality capability by coaching colleagues, sharing knowledge across sites and turning project lessons into continuous improvement.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong knowledge of quality systems, food safety, good manufacturing practices, product development and manufacturing.

• Applying root-cause analysis, risk analysis and failure mode analysis to complex design and production challenges.

• Using project management skills to align priorities, manage several developments and deliver practical solutions.

• Collaborating assertively and transparently, influencing decisions while balancing quality requirements with business realities.

• Demonstrating agility and adaptability while navigating complexity, shifting priorities and evolving project needs.

• Communicating fluently and effectively in English across all levels of the organization; proficiency in additional languages is an advantage.

At Nestlé, we care about our people

We offer a competitive and well-rounded benefits package designed to support your growth and wellbeing at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process
We are committed to a fair and transparent internal hiring process and ensure all applications are treated confidentially.

Your application will typically include an initial review, conversations with Talent Acquisition and the hiring team, followed by a final discussion.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

Essere una forza per il bene e crescere attraverso esperienze che ti spingono oltre

Come specialista di qualità della macchina presso il Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee & Beverages , la vostra missione è quella di costruire fiducia e offrire esperienze di consumo eccezionali incorporando la sicurezza alimentare, la conformità e la qualità nei sistemi di bevande sia Nespresso che Nestlé Dolce Gusto fin dalle prime fasi di progettazione. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con project manager, team di categoria, fabbriche, partner normativi e legali, servizi di consumo e fornitori. Questa è la vostra occasione per guidare l'innovazione all'avanguardia, rafforzare la vostra esperienza e fornire risultati significativi per creare esperienze di consumo uniche a livello globale.

Come farete un impatto come specialista di qualità della macchina

• Salvaguardare la sicurezza alimentare, la conformità normativa e le aspettative dei consumatori in tutto lo sviluppo del sistema delle bevande.

• Integrare la qualità attraverso la progettazione di nuovi prodotti, imballaggi, macchine e linee di produzione per migliorare la consegna in tempo reale.

• Guidare piani di validazione robusti, requisiti di qualità e capacità di processo dall'ideazione attraverso approvazione tecnica e lancio.

• Anticipazione dei rischi di qualità attraverso analisi, valutazione del rischio e analisi della modalità di fallimento, consentendo decisioni pragmatiche.

• Risolvere i problemi di qualità con le fabbriche e i team di servizi di consumo e garantire azioni correttive rafforzare gli sviluppi futuri.

• Capacità di costruzione di qualità allenando i colleghi, condividere le conoscenze sui siti e trasformare le lezioni di progetto in miglioramento continuo.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare una forte conoscenza di sistemi di qualità, sicurezza alimentare, buone pratiche di produzione, sviluppo del prodotto e produzione.

• Applicando analisi, analisi dei rischi e analisi delle modalità di guasto a complesse sfide di progettazione e produzione.

• Utilizzando le competenze di project management per allineare le priorità, gestire diversi sviluppi e fornire soluzioni pratiche.

• Collaborando in modo assertivo e trasparente, influenzando le decisioni, bilanciando i requisiti di qualità con le realtà aziendali.

• Dimostrare agilità e adattabilità durante la navigazione della complessità, spostando le priorità e le esigenze di progetto in evoluzione.

• Comunicare fluentemente ed efficacemente in inglese su tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione; la competenza in lingue aggiuntive è un vantaggio.

A Nestlé, ci preoccupiamo della nostra gente

Offriamo un pacchetto di vantaggi competitivo e ben arrotondato progettato per sostenere la vostra crescita e benessere sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione
Ci impegniamo a un processo di assunzione interno equo e trasparente e assicuriamo che tutte le applicazioni siano trattate con riservatezza.

La tua applicazione in genere includerà una recensione iniziale, conversazioni con Talent Acquisition e il team di assunzione, seguita da una discussione finale.

Pronto a crescere con noi?

Applicare ora e crescere attraverso esperienze che ti spingono oltre.

Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full-time, 100%
Contract type / duration: Fixed-term contract, 12 months

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Patent Specialist Nutrition & Health at Société des Produits Nestlé S.A., your mission is to help identify, protect and manage innovations emerging from Nestlé’s research and development activities. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with patent counsels, scientists, innovation teams, legal experts and business partners across Nutrition & Health. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and deliver meaningful results that make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Patent Specialist Nutrition & Health

• Supporting the protection and management of Nutrition & Health innovations across the patent lifecycle, from invention capture to portfolio maintenance.

• Contributing to patentability assessments, prior-art searches and freedom-to-operate activities that guide research and business decisions.

• Preparing patent landscape and competitive intelligence insights that strengthen understanding of the external innovation environment.

• Collaborating with scientists, inventors and innovation teams across Nestlé Research and Nutrition & Health research and development.

• Assisting with patent filing and prosecution activities in partnership with experienced patent counsels and external patent attorneys.

• Building practical intellectual property expertise through mentoring, hands-on learning and exposure to multidisciplinary innovation projects.

What will make you successful

• Bringing a strong scientific foundation in life sciences, nutrition, food science, biochemistry, biotechnology, chemistry, pharmacy, health sciences or a related discipline.

• Applying analytical thinking to understand complex technologies and translate scientific information into clear patent-related insights.

• Using your interest in intellectual property, innovation and patent protection to learn quickly and contribute with curiosity and precision.

• Collaborating proactively with scientists, inventors, patent professionals and business partners while managing multiple priorities with attention to detail.

• Communicating fluently in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Come farete un impatto come specialista brevetto Nutrizione & Salute

• Sostenere la protezione e la gestione delle innovazioni Nutrition & Health in tutto il ciclo di vita del brevetto, dalla cattura dell'invenzione alla manutenzione del portafoglio.

• Collaborando con scienziati, inventori e team di innovazione attraverso la ricerca e lo sviluppo di Nestlé Research e Nutrition & Health.

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation

As a Senior Technician in Analytical Chemistry at Nestlé Research, your mission is to develop and manage analytical methods that support food compliance, chemical contaminant risk assessment, and risk mitigation. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with team and project members, technical services, analytical groups, business partners, quality teams, technology providers, and external suppliers. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Technician in Analytical Chemistry

• Developing analytical methods that strengthen food safety, compliance, and chemical contaminant risk assessment.

• Managing advanced laboratory equipment to deliver reliable data and high-quality analytical results.

• Driving method validation, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement in line with quality standards.

• Supporting technical assistance to markets and partners with practical recommendations and robust troubleshooting.

• Contributing to scientific reports, laboratory procedures, publications, and clear communication of analytical outcomes.

• Coaching apprentices and students while sharing technical knowledge across teams and working areas.

• Ensuring good laboratory practices, and promoting a mindset of safety in the laboratory

This is your opportunity to grow your expertise and deliver meaningful results that help improve lives through nutrition innovation worldwide.

• Leading the development, technical support and global deployment of digital manufacturing and automation solutions that improve reliability, efficiency and operational performance across factories.

• Driving the standardization and continuous improvement of manufacturing execution systems, operational technology and automation solutions across Nutrition and Health sites.

• Building strong partnerships with factories, project teams and technology suppliers to turn emerging digital technologies into scalable business value.

• Delivering expert guidance for investment projects, from design and commissioning to qualification, validation and handover to operations.

• Enabling secure, reliable and actionable manufacturing data through data integration and engineering initiatives that support digital transformation.

• Coaching teams and sharing best practices that strengthen digital and automation capabilities across a global manufacturing community.

• Bringing strong expertise in digital technologies applied to manufacturing, automation, industrial software and operational technology, supported by a Master’s degree in Engineering with a background in digital technologies.

• Warten mechanischer Anlagen und der Infrastruktur zur Unterstützung eines sicheren und zuverlässigen Betriebs.

• Verbessern von Maschinen und Anlagen zur Stärkung der Leistung und langfristigen Zuverlässigkeit.

jobs.title: Senior Acquisitions & Business Development Manager

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire principal des acquisitions et du développement des affaires

jobs.description:
Location: Vevey - Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a Senior Acquisitions & Business Development Manager within our global M&A team, you will play a key role in shaping and executing strategic corporate projects that support the long-term growth of the Nestlé Group. Leading acquisitions, divestments, joint-ventures and other high-impact initiatives, you will ensure strong governance, rigorous valuation, and effective negotiations that create value and manage risk. Working closely with Zone and SBU leadership, Market Heads and CFOs, senior management, and specialist internal and external partners, you will help turn strategic opportunities into measurable business impact on a global scale, working across categories and geographies.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Acquisition & Business Development Manager

• Partner with Zones and Strategic Business Units to shape M&A strategies and evaluate potential acquisition or divestment opportunities.

• Lead end-to-end acquisition and divestment processes, ensuring projects follow the appropriate governance and approval requirements.

• Assess financial, strategic, and operational risks and opportunities to strengthen decision-making and negotiation positions.

• Lead negotiations on transaction agreements to optimize value and manage risk for Nestlé.

• Provide timely, clear, and decision-relevant information to senior management throughout the project lifecycle.

• Coordinate internal specialists and manage relationships with investment banks, financial advisers, accounting advisers, legal counsel, and other external partners to ensure the timely completion of projects.

What will make you successful

• Extensive experience in mergers and acquisitions or in leading complex projects within a multinational organization, consultancy, investment bank, or financial advisory environment.

• Strong expertise in financial management, business analysis, valuation, governance, risk management, and strategic business planning.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across functions, businesses, and geographies.

• Fluency in English, with additional languages considered an advantage, combined with flexibility, sound judgement, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex global environment.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, interviews with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role on the date listed above, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Come farete un impatto come Senior Acquisition & Business Development Manager

• Partner con Zones e Strategic Business Units per modellare le strategie M&A e valutare potenziali opportunità di acquisizione o di immersione.

• Condurre processi di acquisizione e disinvestimento end-to-end, assicurando ai progetti di seguire i requisiti di governance e approvazione appropriati.

• Valutare i rischi finanziari, strategici e operativi e le opportunità di rafforzare le posizioni decisionali e di negoziazione.

• Condurre i negoziati sugli accordi di transazione per ottimizzare il valore e gestire il rischio per Nestlé.

• Fornire informazioni tempestive, chiare e rilevanti per la gestione senior in tutto il ciclo di vita del progetto.

• Forte competenza nella gestione finanziaria, analisi aziendale, valutazione, governance, gestione dei rischi e pianificazione strategica aziendale.

• Eccellente gestione delle parti interessate, capacità di comunicazione e negoziazione, con la capacità di costruire relazioni affidabili tra funzioni, aziende e geografie.

• Fluency in inglese, con altre lingue considerato un vantaggio, combinato con flessibilità, giudizio sonoro, e la capacità di operare efficacemente in un ambiente globale complesso.

Als Senior Acquisitions & Business Development Manager in unserem globalen M&A-Team spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung und Durchführung strategischer Unternehmensprojekte, die das langfristige Wachstum der Nestlé Group unterstützen. Führende Akquisitionen, Veräußerungen, Joint-Ventures und andere einflussreiche Initiativen, werden Sie eine starke Governance, strenge Bewertung und effektive Verhandlungen sicherstellen, die Wert schaffen und Risiken managen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Leitung von Zone und SBU, Market Heads und CFOs, der Geschäftsleitung sowie internen und externen spezialisierten Partnern werden Sie dazu beitragen, strategische Chancen in messbare Geschäftsauswirkungen auf globaler Ebene zu verwandeln, indem Sie über Kategorien und Regionen hinweg arbeiten.

Wie Sie als Senior Acquisition & Business Development Manager Einfluss nehmen können

• Zusammenarbeit mit Zonen und strategischen Geschäftseinheiten, um M&A-Strategien zu gestalten und potenzielle Akquisitions- oder Veräußerungsmöglichkeiten zu bewerten.

• Führen Sie End-to-End-Akquisitions- und Desinvestitionsprozesse, um sicherzustellen, dass Projekte den entsprechenden Governance- und Genehmigungsanforderungen entsprechen.

• Bewerten Sie finanzielle, strategische und operative Risiken und Chancen, um Entscheidungs- und Verhandlungspositionen zu stärken.

• Führen Sie Verhandlungen über Transaktionsvereinbarungen, um den Wert zu optimieren und das Risiko für Nestlé zu steuern.

• Bereitstellung zeitnaher, klarer und entscheidungsrelevanter Informationen für die Geschäftsleitung während des gesamten Projektlebenszyklus.

• Koordinieren Sie interne Spezialisten und verwalten Sie die Beziehungen zu Investmentbanken, Finanzberatern, Buchhaltungsberatern, Rechtsberatern und anderen externen Partnern, um den rechtzeitigen Abschluss von Projekten sicherzustellen.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in Fusionen und Übernahmen oder in der Leitung komplexer Projekte innerhalb einer multinationalen Organisation, Beratung, Investmentbank oder Finanzberatung.

• Starke Expertise in den Bereichen Finanzmanagement, Geschäftsanalyse, Bewertung, Governance, Risikomanagement und strategische Geschäftsplanung.

• Exzellentes Stakeholder-Management, Kommunikation und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, vertrauenswürdige Beziehungen über Funktionen, Unternehmen und Regionen hinweg aufzubauen.

• fließende Englischkenntnisse mit zusätzlichen Sprachen als Vorteil, kombiniert mit Flexibilität, fundiertem Urteilsvermögen und der Fähigkeit, in einem komplexen globalen Umfeld effektiv zu arbeiten.

• Demonstrieren Sie Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen, während Sie Ideen in messbare Auswirkungen übersetzen und gemeinsame Werte schaffen.

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation

As a Proficiency Testing Coordinator at Nestlé Research, your mission is to plan, coordinate, and manage internal proficiency tests from test design to final result reporting while supporting external schemes and delivering reliable insights for continuous improvement. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with R&D teams, quality experts, laboratories, factories, technology partners, and external proficiency testing providers. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

• Coordinating internal proficiency testing schemes that help laboratories deliver reliable, comparable, and high-quality analytical results.

• Managing the full testing cycle, from scheme design and sample coordination to data evaluation, reporting, and stakeholder communication.

• Partnering with internal experts and external providers to ensure smooth delivery of standard and tailored proficiency testing programs.

• Strengthening quality and compliance by supporting accredited processes, customer feedback follow-up, and continuous improvement actions.

• Delivering consolidated reports and insights that support management decisions, stakeholder engagement, and program performance.

• Supporting digital tools and users by following up on application improvements, issue resolution, and service excellence.

What will make you successful

• Applying experience or a strong interest in quality assurance, proficiency testing, and laboratory quality systems to support reliable testing outcomes.

• Using good laboratory practices, statistical methods, and accredited quality requirements to strengthen compliance and continuous improvement.

• Collaborating with a service-oriented mindset, clear communication, strong organization, and the initiative to solve problems efficiently.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset, to create shared value.

• Fornire report consolidati e approfondimenti che supportano le decisioni di gestione, l'impegno degli stakeholder e le prestazioni del programma.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare un background di chimica attraverso un CFC, laurea, o qualifica equivalente, combinato con almeno tre anni di esperienza di laboratorio hands-on.

• Applicare l'esperienza o un forte interesse per la garanzia della qualità, test di competenza e sistemi di qualità di laboratorio per supportare risultati di test affidabili.

• Utilizzando buone pratiche di laboratorio, metodi statistici e requisiti di qualità accreditati per rafforzare la conformità e il miglioramento continuo.

• Collaborare con una mentalità orientata al servizio, una comunicazione chiara, una forte organizzazione e l'iniziativa per risolvere i problemi in modo efficiente.

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese.

• Portare la collaborazione, il pensiero fresco, domande audaci, il rispetto e una mentalità positiva, orientata al benessere, per creare valore condiviso.

A Nestlé Research, mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti dei dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati a un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. Il processo di assunzione include tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. A seconda del ruolo, può essere inclusa una valutazione video. As an Associate Specialist - Regenerative Agriculture (Coffee & Cocoa) at Nestlé Research, your mission is to contribute to the design and delivery of coffee and cocoa regenerative agriculture research aligned with corporate Creating Shared Value commitments and the business-endorsed Nestlé Institute of Agricultural Sciences research strategy. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with agricultural systems teams, project leaders, researchers, agronomists, operations teams, farmers, research institutes, universities and external partners. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Forschungsleitern, Wissenschafts- und Technologieteams, Rechts- und Vertragspartnern, Universitäten, Forschungsinstituten, Start-ups, wissenschaftlichen Verlagen, Verbänden und externen Experten helfen Sie dabei, Ideen in nachhaltige und innovative Lösungen für Menschen, Haustiere und den Planeten zu verwandeln.

Wie Sie als Research Alliances & Science Insourcing Lead Einfluss nehmen können

• Führen der Forschungsallianzen und der Science-Insourcing-Strategie zum Aufbau hochwertiger Partnerschaften mit Hochschulen, Startups, Verlagen, wissenschaftlichen und Innovationsökosystemen.

• Förderung strategischer Kooperationen, die die Entdeckung beschleunigen, die Innovationswirkung stärken und die Prioritäten von Nestlé Research unterstützen.

• Schaffung eines nahtlosen Zugangs zu internen und externen wissenschaftlichen Erkenntnissen durch die Verbindung von Forschern mit Experten, wissenschaftlicher Literatur, Verlagen, Informationsquellen und Forschungsdiensten, die Nestlé Research Fähigkeiten erweitern.

• Die Transformation wissenschaftlicher Intelligenz in eine strategische Fähigkeit durch die Identifizierung, Verknüpfung und Übersetzung von aufkommenden wissenschaftlichen Trends, Publikationen und externem Fachwissen in umsetzbare Erkenntnisse für Forschung und Innovation.

• Stärkung des wissenschaftlichen Rufs von Nestlé Research durch den Aufbau vertrauenswürdiger Beziehungen zu Universitäten, Talentpools und externen Vordenkern.

• Entwicklung eines engagierten, integrativen und zukunftsfähigen Teams, das Fähigkeiten aufbaut, die Zusammenarbeit fördert und gemeinsame Prioritäten setzt.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Bringen Sie einen PhD oder einen gleichwertigen wissenschaftlichen Hintergrund mit, kombiniert mit der Glaubwürdigkeit und Neugier, Spitzenwissenschaft mit Geschäftsanforderungen, Innovationsmöglichkeiten und langfristiger Wertschöpfung zu verbinden.

• Anwendung von mehr als 10 Jahren Erfahrung in Forschung und Entwicklung, wissenschaftlicher Innovation, externer Zusammenarbeit oder verwandter wissenschaftlicher Führung, um Strategien zu gestalten, Interessengruppen zu beeinflussen und messbare Auswirkungen zu erzielen.

• Nutzung starker Erfahrung in Nestlé Research, Nestlé Product Technology Centern und der breiteren F & E-Organisation, um Verbindungen zwischen Fähigkeiten, Partnerschaften, Fachwissen und wissenschaftlichen Dienstleistungen zu fördern und die Ausrichtung auf Geschäfts- und Innovationsprioritäten sicherzustellen.

• Nachweis des Erfolgs in akademischen Partnerschaften, Innovationsökosystemen, mit der nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, vertrauenswürdige Beziehungen aufzubauen und messbare Auswirkungen zu erzielen.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Initiativen in einer direkten oder indirekten Führungsrolle.

• Mitbringen von Erfahrung in der Verwaltung, Entwicklung oder strategischen Nutzung von wissenschaftlichen Infrastrukturen, Forschungsdienstleistungen, Wissensplattformen oder gemeinsamen Fähigkeiten.

• Demonstrieren starker strategischer Kommunikation und beeinflussender Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe wissenschaftliche Themen in überzeugende Narrative zu übersetzen, Ausrichtung aufzubauen und verschiedene interne und externe Interessengruppen einzubeziehen.

• Bringt Zusammenarbeit, intellektuelle Neugier, frisches Denken, konstruktive Herausforderung, Respekt und eine positive Denkweise.

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei bedarf angemessene unterkünfte zu bieten. jobs.description:
Strategic Research Operations

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Lab Data Technology Specialist at Nestlé Research within our Computational Sciences department, you will be responsible for reinforcing our laboratory data foundations to help unlock the full value of the data generated by our scientific instruments and laboratory systems. Sitting at the intersection of science, laboratory data, and modern data engineering, you will leverage latest data technologies and AI for coding tools to transform raw, heterogeneous scientific data into trusted, well-documented, and reusable data assets that accelerate impactful scientific research.

How you’ll make an impact as a Lab Data Technology Specialist

• Partner with laboratory stakeholders. data domain owners, lab business analysts together with data architects and engineers to translate functional requirements into scalable, and well-documented technical solutions, ensuring alignment between scientific workflows and technological capabilities

• Enable new and existing laboratory instruments end to end, from understanding the scientific workflow and data outputs to defining and establishing connectivity and data flow (LIMS, robotics, automation platforms, downstream systems), in collaboration with IT network, security specialists

• Collaborate with internal and external professionals to propose and implement customizations to lab digital platforms used (LIMS, instrument integration, technology specific data processing, metadata capture) in view of efficiency, quality, traceability, and governance by design

• Identify opportunities to increase value of lab data gathered across different sources by leveraging data technologies (data integrations, data warehousing, automated data quality checks, etc)

• Support testing, deployment, change management, and continuous improvement of compliant, scalable lab solutions, including AI-enabled opportunities to strengthen data flows and unlock value from lab data

What will make you successful

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a scientific or computational discipline (e.g., Chemistry, life sciences, Bioinformatics, Cheminformatics, Data Engineering, Computer Science), or equivalent experience.

• Solid experience in applying data engineering to scientific, laboratory data

• Required technical skills

•

• LIMS customization, data models, and integration.

• Integrating lab instruments, applications, robots, and IoT with reference databases and data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake).

• Solid grasp of the lab solutions ecosystem: ELN, CDS, LES, multi-omics pipelines, IoT-connected equipment, barcode systems, etc.

• Programming (e.g., Python, R, Java, Groovy).

• Data engineering and modeling — ETL/ELT (Airflow, dbt), APIs, orchestration, SQL/NoSQL — with engineering rigor (Git, CI/CD, testing, data quality, observability, reproducibility).

• Nice-to-have technical skills

• Semantic modeling, ontologies, and knowledge graphs (e.g., RDF/SPARQL, biomedical/chemical vocabularies).

• FAIR data implementation, metadata management, and lineage tooling

• Enabling AI/ML and analytics use cases on scientific data

• Domain exposure in chemistry, biology, food, or omics

• Reporting tools (e.g., DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) is an advantage

• Leveraging Agentic AI to automate data engineering activities

• Required non-technical skills

• Strong problem-solving and hands-on mindset

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• Experience collaborating with external vendors and data professionals and driving delivery through others

• Ability to work in cross-functional and international teams

• Strong organizational and prioritization skills

• Fluent spoken and written English

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to #BreakthroughTogether?

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

Operazioni strategiche di ricerca

Ubicazione: Losanna, Svizzera
Modello di lavoro: ibrido / tempo pieno 100%
Tipo di contratto / durata: Permanente

Formare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

In qualità di Lab Data Technology Specialist presso Nestlé Research all'interno del nostro dipartimento di Scienze Computazionali, sarete responsabili di rafforzare le nostre basi di dati di laboratorio per aiutare a sbloccare il valore completo dei dati generati dai nostri strumenti scientifici e dai sistemi di laboratorio. Seduto all'incrocio tra scienza, dati di laboratorio e ingegneria dei dati moderni, si leverà le ultime tecnologie dei dati e AI per codificare strumenti per trasformare i dati scientifici grezzi, eterogenei in risorse di dati affidabili, ben documentate e riutilizzabili che accelerano la ricerca scientifica di impatto.

Come farete un impatto come esperto di tecnologia dei dati del laboratorio

• Partner con gli stakeholder di laboratorio. proprietari di domini di dati, analisti aziendali di laboratorio insieme a architetti di dati e ingegneri per tradurre requisiti funzionali in soluzioni tecniche scalabili e ben documentate, garantendo allineamento tra flussi di lavoro scientifici e capacità tecnologiche

• Abilitare gli strumenti di laboratorio nuovi ed esistenti finiscono fino alla fine, dalla comprensione del flusso di lavoro scientifico e delle uscite di dati per definire e stabilire la connettività e il flusso di dati (LIMS, robotica, piattaforme di automazione, sistemi a valle), in collaborazione con la rete IT, specialisti della sicurezza

• Collaborare con professionisti interni ed esterni per proporre e implementare personalizzazioni a piattaforme digitali di laboratorio utilizzate (LIMS, integrazione degli strumenti, elaborazione dei dati specifici della tecnologia, cattura dei metadati) in vista di efficienza, qualità, tracciabilità e governance dal design

• Identificare le opportunità per aumentare il valore dei dati di laboratorio raccolti in diverse fonti sfruttando le tecnologie dei dati (integrazione dei dati, data warehousing, controlli automatizzati di qualità dei dati, ecc)

• Test di supporto, distribuzione, gestione dei cambiamenti e miglioramento continuo delle soluzioni di laboratorio conformi e scalabili, comprese le opportunità abilitate all'IA per rafforzare i flussi di dati e sbloccare il valore dai dati di laboratorio

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Laurea o Master in una disciplina scientifica o computazionale (ad esempio, Chimica, scienze della vita, Bioinformatica, Cheminformatica, Ingegneria dei dati, Scienza informatica), o esperienza equivalente.

• Esperienza solida nell'applicazione dell'ingegneria dei dati a dati scientifici e di laboratorio

• Capacità tecniche necessarie

•

• Personalizzazione LIMS, modelli di dati e integrazione.

• Integrazione di strumenti di laboratorio, applicazioni, robot e IoT con database di riferimento e data warehouse (ad esempio, Snowflake).

• Solida presa delle soluzioni di laboratorio ecosistema: ELN, CDS, LES, multi-omics pipelines, apparecchiature IoT-connected, sistemi di codici a barre, ecc.

• Programmazione (ad esempio, Python, R, Java, Groovy).

• Ingegneria dei dati e modellazione — ETL/ELT (Airflow, dbt), API, orchestrazione, SQL/NoSQL — con rigore di ingegneria (Git, CI/CD, test, qualità dei dati, osservabilità, riproducibilità).

• Competenze tecniche belle da avere

• Modellazione semantica, onlogie e grafici di conoscenza (ad esempio, RDF/SPARQL, vocabulari biomedici/chimici).

• implementazione dei dati FAIR, gestione dei metadati e strumenti di linea

• Attivare casi di utilizzo AI/ML e analytics sui dati scientifici

• Esposizione di dominio in chimica, biologia, cibo o omica

• Strumenti di segnalazione (ad esempio, DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) è un vantaggio

• Sfruttamento dell'intelligenza artificiale per automatizzare le attività di ingegneria dei dati

• Competenze non tecniche richieste

• Forte problem-solving e hands-on mentalità

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder

• Esperienza di collaborazione con fornitori esterni e professionisti dei dati e la consegna di guida attraverso altri

• Capacità di lavorare in team interfunzionali e internazionali

• Forte capacità organizzative e di priorità

• Fluente parlato e scritto inglese

A Nestlé Research, mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo.

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti dei dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati in un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione include tipicamente un video intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che un forte elenco di candidati pertinenti è identificato, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto a #BreakthroughTogether?

Applicare ora e plasmare il futuro attraverso scoperte scientifiche e innovazione.

Gestalten Sie die Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen.

Als Lab Data Technology Specialist bei Nestlé Research in unserer Computational Sciences-Abteilung sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, unsere Labordatengrundlagen zu stärken, um den vollen Wert der von unseren wissenschaftlichen Instrumenten und Laborsystemen generierten Daten zu erschließen. An der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft, Labordaten und moderner Datentechnik werden Sie die neuesten Datentechnologien und KI für Codierungswerkzeuge nutzen, um rohe, heterogene wissenschaftliche Daten in vertrauenswürdige, gut dokumentierte und wiederverwendbare Datenbestände umzuwandeln, die eine wirkungsvolle wissenschaftliche Forschung beschleunigen.

Wie Sie als Lab Data Technology Specialist etwas bewirken können

• Partnerschaft mit Laborbeteiligten. Datendomänenbesitzer, Labor-Business-Analysten zusammen mit Datenarchitekten und Ingenieuren, um funktionale Anforderungen in skalierbare und gut dokumentierte technische Lösungen zu übersetzen und so eine Abstimmung zwischen wissenschaftlichen Workflows und technologischen Fähigkeiten zu gewährleisten

• Ermöglichen Sie neue und bestehende Laborinstrumente durchgängig, vom Verständnis des wissenschaftlichen Workflows und der Datenausgabe bis hin zur Definition und Etablierung von Konnektivität und Datenfluss (LIMS, Robotik, Automatisierungsplattformen, nachgelagerte Systeme) in Zusammenarbeit mit IT-Netzwerken und Sicherheitsexperten.

• Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Fachleuten, um Anpassungen an verwendete digitale Laborplattformen (LIMS, Instrumentenintegration, technologiespezifische Datenverarbeitung, Metadatenerfassung) im Hinblick auf Effizienz, Qualität, Rückverfolgbarkeit und Governance by Design vorzuschlagen und umzusetzen

• Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten, den Wert von Labordaten aus verschiedenen Quellen zu erhöhen, indem Sie Datentechnologien nutzen (Datenintegrationen, Data Warehousing, automatisierte Datenqualitätsprüfungen usw.)

• Unterstützung von Testing, Deployment, Change Management und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung konformer, skalierbarer Laborlösungen, einschließlich KI-fähiger Möglichkeiten zur Stärkung des Datenflusses und zur Wertschöpfung aus Labordaten

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in einer wissenschaftlichen oder computergestützten Disziplin (z. B. Chemie, Biowissenschaften, Bioinformatik, Cheminformatik, Data Engineering, Informatik) oder gleichwertige Erfahrung.

• Solide Erfahrung in der Anwendung von Data Engineering auf wissenschaftliche Labordaten

• Erforderliche technische Fähigkeiten

•

• LIMS-Anpassung, Datenmodelle und Integration.

• Integration von Laborinstrumenten, Anwendungen, Robotern und IoT mit Referenzdatenbanken und Data Warehouses (z.B. Snowflake).

• Solides Verständnis des Ökosystems der Laborlösungen: ELN, CDS, LES, Multi-Omics-Pipelines, IoT-verbundene Geräte, Barcode-Systeme usw.

• Programmierung (z.B. Python, R, Java, Groovy).

Opérations de recherche stratégique

Lieu: Lausanne, Suisse
Modèle de travail: Hybride / Temps plein 100%
Type / durée du contrat : Permanent

Façonner l'avenir par des percées scientifiques et l'innovation.

En tant que spécialiste de la technologie des données de laboratoire chez Nestlé Research au sein de notre département des Sciences Computationnelles, vous serez chargé de renforcer nos bases de données de laboratoire pour aider à débloquer toute la valeur des données générées par nos instruments scientifiques et nos systèmes de laboratoire. Assis à l'intersection de la science, des données de laboratoire et de l'ingénierie moderne des données, vous tirerez parti des dernières technologies de données et de l'IA pour coder des outils permettant de transformer des données scientifiques brutes et hétérogènes en données fiables, bien documentées et réutilisables qui accélèrent la recherche scientifique.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que spécialiste de la technologie des données de laboratoire

• Partenaire avec les intervenants du laboratoire. propriétaires de domaines de données, analystes d'affaires de laboratoire, architectes de données et ingénieurs pour traduire les exigences fonctionnelles en solutions techniques évolutives et bien documentées, assurant l'alignement entre les flux de travail scientifiques et les capacités technologiques

• Permettre aux nouveaux et existants instruments de laboratoire de se terminer, de la compréhension du flux de travail scientifique et des sorties de données à la définition et à l'établissement de la connectivité et du flux de données (LIMS, robotique, plateformes d'automatisation, systèmes en aval), en collaboration avec le réseau informatique, les spécialistes de la sécurité

• Collaborer avec des professionnels internes et externes pour proposer et mettre en œuvre des personnalisations aux plateformes numériques de laboratoire utilisées (LIMS, intégration d'instruments, traitement de données spécifiques à la technologie, capture de métadonnées) en vue de l'efficacité, de la qualité, de la traçabilité et de la gouvernance par la conception

• Déterminer les possibilités d'accroître la valeur des données de laboratoire recueillies dans différentes sources en tirant parti des technologies de données (intégration des données, entreposage des données, contrôle automatisé de la qualité des données, etc.)

• Soutenir les essais, le déploiement, la gestion du changement et l'amélioration continue des solutions de laboratoire adaptables et évolutives, y compris les possibilités permettant de renforcer les flux de données et de débloquer la valeur des données de laboratoire

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en sciences ou en informatique (p. ex. chimie, sciences de la vie, bioinformatique, chimie, génie des données, informatique) ou expérience équivalente.

• Une solide expérience dans l'application de l'ingénierie des données aux données scientifiques et de laboratoire

• Compétences techniques requises

•

• Personnalisation LIMS, modèles de données et intégration.

• Intégrer les instruments de laboratoire, les applications, les robots et l'IdO avec les bases de données de référence et les entrepôts de données (p. ex., Snowflake).

• Une bonne compréhension de l'écosystème des solutions de laboratoire : ELN, CDS, ERP, pipelines multi-omiques, équipements connectés à l'IoT, systèmes de codes à barres, etc.

• Programmation (p. ex. Python, R, Java, Groovy).

• Ingénierie et modélisation des données — ETL/ELT (Airflow, dbt), API, orchestration, SQL/NoSQL — avec rigueur technique (Git, CI/CD, test, qualité des données, observabilité, reproductibilité).

• Bonnes compétences techniques

• Modélisation sémantique, ontologies et graphiques de connaissances (p. ex. RDF/SPARQL, vocabulaires biomédicaux/chimiques).

• Mise en œuvre des données FAIR, gestion des métadonnées et outils de lignage

• Valorisation des cas d'utilisation de l'IA/ML et de l'analyse sur les données scientifiques

• Exposition de domaine en chimie, biologie, nourriture ou omique

• Les outils de rapport (p. ex. DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) constituent un avantage

• Exploiter l'IA Agentic pour automatiser les activités d'ingénierie des données

• Compétences non techniques requises

• Résolution de problèmes et état d'esprit pratique

• Excellentes compétences en communication et gestion des parties prenantes

• Expérience de la collaboration avec les fournisseurs externes et les professionnels de l'information et de la conduite de la livraison par d'autres

• Capacité de travailler en équipes interfonctionnelles et internationales

• Compétences solides en matière d'organisation et de hiérarchisation

• Anglais parlé et écrit couramment

À Nestlé Research, nous plaçons les gens au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Options de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybride (pour les rôles de bureau)

• Jours fériés payés au-delà des exigences légales

• Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour développer votre carrière

• Prime fondée sur les performances

• Contribution aux soins de santé et accès au Programme d'aide aux employés

• Une forte contribution de l'employeur à votre régime de retraite

• Congé parental généreux et solutions globales de soutien familial

• Réductions attrayantes pour les employés pour divers produits et services

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sécuritaire pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend généralement une entrevue vidéo avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents est établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé communiquera uniquement avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses électroniques officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à n'importe quelle étape du processus d'embauche.

jobs.description:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Deadline for application: 31 July 2026

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further.

As an Associate R&D Specialist System Performance at Nestlé, your mission is to drive the capability of Nestlé's in-home portioned systems, such as Nespresso and Nescafé Dolce Gusto, to consistently deliver the perfect cup and user experience. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with Front End Innovation, Development and Industrialization teams. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as an Associate R&D Specialist System Performance

• Driving system performance to deliver consistent cup quality and an excellent user experience across beverage systems.

• Building science-based understanding of machine, product and packaging interactions to optimize design decisions.

• Leveraging models, data analysis and digital tools to accelerate learning beyond physical testing.

• Providing clear physical explanations of system phenomena to support confident technical decisions.

• Contributing to troubleshooting, root cause analysis and commissioning support to enable successful project delivery.

• Strengthening cross-functional collaboration and competitive benchmarking to support innovation and continuous improvement.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong knowledge of physics, fluid mechanics and beverage system performance to solve complex technical challenges.

• Applying a science-based mindset to understand interactions between machine, product and packaging.

• Using data analysis, modelling and digital tools, including R or Python, to generate insights and guide decisions.

• Collaborating across product, packaging and machine teams with curiosity, openness and a hands-on approach.

• Communicating fluently in French and English.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Nestlé, we care about our people.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Come farete un impatto come prestazioni del sistema di R&D

• Le prestazioni del sistema di guida per offrire una qualità coppe costante e un'eccellente esperienza utente nei sistemi di bevande.

• Costruire la comprensione scientifica delle interazioni tra macchine, prodotti e imballaggi per ottimizzare le decisioni di progettazione.

• Sfrutta modelli, analisi dei dati e strumenti digitali per accelerare l'apprendimento oltre i test fisici.

• Contribuire alla risoluzione dei problemi, all'analisi delle cause principali e al supporto di messa in servizio per consentire la consegna del progetto di successo.

• Rafforzare la collaborazione interfunzionale e il benchmarking competitivo per sostenere l'innovazione e il miglioramento continuo.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare una forte conoscenza della fisica, della meccanica dei fluidi e delle prestazioni del sistema delle bevande per risolvere complesse sfide tecniche.

• Applicare una mentalità basata sulla scienza per comprendere le interazioni tra macchina, prodotto e imballaggio.

• Utilizzando l'analisi dei dati, la modellazione e gli strumenti digitali, tra cui R o Python, per generare intuizioni e decisioni guida.

• Collaborare tra team di prodotti, imballaggi e macchine con curiosità, apertura e approccio pratico.

• Comunicare fluentemente in francese e inglese.

• Dimostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo.

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati a un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. Che cosa vi farà successo

• Applicare la consapevolezza scientifica e regolamentare, tra cui la familiarità con le linee guida esterne e le normative pertinenti alle relazioni professionali e di advocacy per sviluppare programmi e materiali sanitari affidabili di marca e non marchiati.

• Utilizzando la pianificazione strategica, l'analisi dei dati e la leadership del progetto per spostare più priorità dalla comprensione all'azione, con l'esperienza globale altamente preferito.

• Collaborare con l'influenza e l'integrità dei team globali, costruendo relazioni interne ed esterne affidabili.

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese.

• Dimostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo.

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare
