Sei eine Kraft für das Gute und beschleunige Veränderungen, die das Leben und den Planeten verbessern.

Als Global Medical Communication Lead bei Nestlé Nutrition and Health ist es Ihre Mission, die globale, auf Gesundheitsberufe ausgerichtete Kommunikation für das Premium-Vitamin-, Mineralstoff- und Ergänzungsportfolio zu gestalten und die neueste Wissenschaft in überzeugende Marken- und Nicht-Marken-Engagements zu übersetzen, die neue und bestehende Produkte unterstützen. Sie werden einen Unterschied machen, indem Sie eng mit Marketing, regulatorischen und wissenschaftlichen Angelegenheiten, Ernährungswissenschaft, Forschung und Entwicklung, regionalen und Marktteams, externen Agenturen, Forschungspartnern und wissenschaftlichen Experten zusammenarbeiten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, Eigenverantwortung zu übernehmen, Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und einen großen Unterschied zu machen.

Wie Sie als Global Medical Communication Lead etwas bewirken werden

• Entwicklung globaler Engagement- und Kommunikationspläne, die das Verständnis von Gesundheitsexperten stärken und die Empfehlung, Interessenvertretung und Akzeptanz im Premium-Vitamin-, Mineralstoff- und Ergänzungsportfolio erhöhen.

• Erstellen von überzeugenden wissenschaftlichen Kommunikationsmaterialien über persönliche, digitale und soziale Kanäle, um neue Produkteinführungen und etablierte Produktkonzepte zu unterstützen.

• Gestaltung von Marktbewusstseinsinitiativen, die wissenschaftliche Glaubwürdigkeit aufbauen und nachhaltiges Portfoliowachstum unterstützen.

• Führende globale Programme, Kongressaktivitäten, runde Tische und marken- und nicht markenbezogene Beratungsangebote, die vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu medizinischen Fachkräften vertiefen.

• Zusammenarbeit zwischen globalen, regionalen und Marktteams, um Kommunikations-Toolkits bereitzustellen, die relevant, konsistent und bereit für die lokale Einführung sind.

• Aufbau produktiver Partnerschaften mit wissenschaftlichen Experten und Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), Agenturen und Forschungspartnern, um Erkenntnisse und Erkenntnisse in sinnvolles Engagement umzuwandeln.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Mitbringen von umfangreichen medizinischen Marketing-Erfahrung in Ernährung, Pharmazeutika oder Consumer Healthcare-Umgebungen.

• Anwendung des wissenschaftlichen und regulatorischen Bewusstseins, einschließlich der Vertrautheit mit externen Richtlinien und Vorschriften, die für Angehörige der Gesundheitsberufe relevant sind, und der Interessenvertretung, um glaubwürdige Programme und Materialien für Angehörige der Gesundheitsberufe zu entwickeln.

• Strategische Planung, Datenanalyse und Projektleitung nutzen, um mehrere Prioritäten von der Erkenntnis zum Handeln zu bewegen, wobei globale Erfahrung sehr bevorzugt wird.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Einfluss und Integrität in globalen Teams und Aufbau vertrauenswürdiger interner und externer Beziehungen.

• fließend auf Englisch kommunizieren.

• Demonstrieren Sie Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen.

Bei Nestlé Nutrition and Health stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun.

Unsere Vorteile sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Wachstum und Wohlbefinden zu unterstützen, damit Sie bei der Arbeit und im Leben gedeihen können:

• Flexible Arbeitsoptionen, einschließlich hybrider Arbeitsmöglichkeiten (für Office-basierte Rollen)

• Bezahlter Urlaub über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Karriere zu erweitern

• Leistungsbasierter Bonus

• Gesundheitsbeitrag und Zugang zum Employee Assistance Program

• Starker Arbeitgeberbeitrag zu Ihrem Pensionsplan

• Großzügiger Elternurlaub und umfassende Familienunterstützungslösungen

• Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte für verschiedene Produkte und Dienstleistungen

Wir verpflichten uns zu einer inklusiven und respektvollen Einstellungserfahrung und freuen uns, bei Bedarf angemessene Unterkünfte zu bieten. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur unterstützt, mit modernen Installationen und Verfahren, um eine sichere Umgebung für alle zu gewährleisten.

Der Einstellungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Videointerview mit Talent Acquisition, ein Interview mit dem Einstellungsteam und eine abschließende Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir überprüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingegangen sind, und schließen die Rolle, sobald eine starke Liste relevanter Kandidaten identifiziert wurde, daher empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Act. Rate: Full-Time, 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent contract

Start date: February 2027

Deadline for applications: 25 September 2026

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As the Head of Global Business Services Finance at Nestlé, your mission is to act as a key finance partner to the Head of GBS and the GBS Management Team. You will shape the financial roadmap, challenge business decisions, and ensure disciplined planning, performance management, cost transparency and value realization across the global GBS network. Working closely with Center Heads, End-to-End solution leads, Global Process Owners, Markets, IT & Digital, and external partners, you will provide forward-looking insights, enable fact-based decisions, and strengthen accountability for financial outcomes. You will lead an international finance team in different locations and help GBS deliver sustainable efficiency, effectiveness, and business value.

How you’ll make an impact as a Head of GBS Finance

• Bring deep expertise in the operational financial management of Global Business Services, using cost, efficiency, quality and service-performance insights to improve both efficiency and effectiveness.

• While leveraging AI tools, develop and maintain unit-cost, productivity and service-performance measures that connect financial outcomes with operational volumes, quality and service levels. Use internal and external benchmarks to identify improvement opportunities.

• Planning, coordinating and maintaining cost control of our Business Centers operations, measuring performance against plan and proposing necessary action plans to achieve targets in a context of important transition plan.

• Ensure challenging stretched targets are set for each Shared Service Center, end-to-end solution lead and Management Services unit, and tracking performance in a timely manner.

• Establish and govern a consistent framework to validate, track and report productivity, transformation benefits and value delivery, including agreed baselines, ownership, timing and reconciliation to reported financial results.

• Ensure a robust, documented and transparent billing and reconciliation process across the GBS network, including accurate and timely charges to internal customers, clear allocation drivers, dispute resolution and compliance with applicable transfer-pricing and accounting requirements.

• Own and continuously improve a transparent, driver-based costing and charging model for GBS services. Define financial evaluation and performance-tracking methodologies, assess business cases and contract changes, and ensure continuity plans reflect current financial exposures and operational requirements.

• Lead financial and commercial governance of external service providers, including contract economics, rate cards, indexation, volume commitments, service credits, change requests, invoice validation and value-for-money assessments.

• Lead, develop and inspire your team in an international environment while working collaboratively and cross functionally with IT & Digital, Global Process Owners and Markets.

What will make you successful

• Demonstrating senior finance leadership experience in GBS operational financial models and in complex global organizations, supported by relevant finance, accounting or business qualification.

• Applying financial analysis and co-piloting experience to various senior stakeholders through a strong command of management accounting, planning and forecasting, service costing, investment appraisal, financial controls and commercial contract management.

• Developing and improving financial systems and major business processes, with exposure to audit, project financial evaluation and contract reviews.

• Strong focus on compliance, rock solid reporting and internal controls.

• Managing and developing people, including virtual teams, with good organizational and planning skills.

• Communicating fluently in English, with superior written and verbal communication skills to effectively address and influence all levels, leadership team and internal customers.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we care about our people

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities

• Performance based bonus

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to a fair and transparent hiring process and ensure all applications are treated confidentially.

Your application will typically include an initial review, conversations with Talent Acquisition, and the hiring team, followed by a final discussion.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

Be a force for good and help nurture a healthier generation

As a Senior Manufacturing Specialist, your mission is to lead manufacturing support for innovation and renovation projects, providing technical and operational expertise that enables successful industrialization and sustainable factory performance. At our research and development center in Konolfingen, Switzerland, we develop science-proven nutrition products, processes and packaging, while providing technical support to Nestlé factories worldwide. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with research and development teams, businesses, markets, factories, suppliers and external partners. This is your opportunity to grow your expertise and help improve lives through nutrition innovation worldwide.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Manufacturing Specialist

• Leading manufacturing support across innovation and renovation projects to turn promising concepts into competitive products, processes and systems

• Driving early manufacturing input, risk assessment and technical decisions that improve readiness, speed and implementation quality

• Delivering reliable technical assistance during industrialization, start-ups and product launches to achieve efficient, sustainable factory performance

• Building and documenting specialist knowledge, standards and guidelines that strengthen manufacturing capability across sites

• Exploring breakthrough technologies and processes that create new opportunities for innovation, productivity and competitive advantage

• Developing factory knowledge through training, coaching and networks that accelerate learning and cross-site collaboration

What will make you successful

• Bringing deep manufacturing, engineering or product development expertise to industrialization and factory support

• Applying current quality, safety and hygiene standards to deliver robust and sustainable solutions

• Using data analysis, digital tools and structured problem solving to identify risks and improve performance

• Collaborating across functions, sites and cultures while communicating technical recommendations clearly to varied audiences

• Communicating fluently in English

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

At our research and development center in Konolfingen, Switzerland, we develop science-proven nutrition products, processes and packaging, while providing technical support to Nestlé factories worldwide. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with research and development teams, businesses, markets, factories, suppliers and external partners. This is your opportunity to grow your expertise and help improve lives through nutrition innovation worldwide.

How you’ll make an impact as a Senior Manufacturing Specialist

• Leading manufacturing support across innovation and renovation projects to turn promising concepts into competitive products, processes and systems

• Driving early manufacturing input, risk assessment and technical decisions that improve readiness, speed and implementation quality

• Delivering reliable technical assistance during industrialization, start-ups and product launches to achieve efficient, sustainable factory performance

• Building and documenting specialist knowledge, standards and guidelines that strengthen manufacturing capability across sites

• Exploring breakthrough technologies and processes that create new opportunities for innovation, productivity and competitive advantage

• Developing factory knowledge through training, coaching and networks that accelerate learning and cross-site collaboration

What will make you successful

• Bringing deep manufacturing, engineering or product development expertise to industrialization and factory support

• Applying current quality, safety and hygiene standards to deliver robust and sustainable solutions

• Using data analysis, digital tools and structured problem solving to identify risks and improve performance

• Collaborating across functions, sites and cultures while communicating technical recommendations clearly to varied audiences

• Communicating fluently in English

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

• Appliquer les normes actuelles de qualité, de sécurité et d'hygiène pour offrir des solutions robustes et durables

• Utiliser l'analyse des données, les outils numériques et la résolution structurée des problèmes pour identifier les risques et améliorer les performances

• Démontrer courage, collaboration, rapidité et apprentissage continu

jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid/[Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Start date: As soon as possible

Deadline for applications: 12 / 07 /2026

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

As a Global Medical Affairs Lead – Diabetes & Obesity at Nestlé Nutrition & Health Strategic Business Unit (SBU) , your mission is to define and execute the global medical and scientific strategy for the Diabetes & Obesity portfolio across the full product lifecycle. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with R&D, commercial teams, local medical teams, and external scientific experts. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and drive evidence-based innovation that improves patient and population health outcomes at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Global Medical Affairs Lead – Diabetes & Obesity

• Leading the global medical strategy by shaping evidence generation and guiding product development across the lifecycle

• Driving cross-functional alignment by connecting R&D, commercial and medical teams to deliver impactful outcomes

• Building strong external engagement by partnering with healthcare professionals, scientific experts and associations

• Delivering high-quality medical education and scientific communication to healthcare providers and internal stakeholders

• Translating scientific evidence into clear, relevant content to support markets and influence clinical practice

• Monitoring scientific developments and competitive activities to inform strategy and strengthen positioning

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in medical and scientific affairs within clinical nutrition or pharmaceutical environments

• Applying the ability to lead evidence generation strategies and translate complex data into actionable insights

• Using strong stakeholder management skills to influence cross-functional teams and external experts

• Collaborating effectively in a global, matrix organization to drive alignment and impact

• Communicating fluently in English

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Nestlé in Switzerland, we place people at the heart of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Questa è la vostra opportunità di prendere la proprietà, crescere la vostra esperienza e guidare l'innovazione basata sulle prove che migliora i risultati della salute del paziente e della popolazione in scala.

Come farete un impatto come Leader Global Medical Affairs – Diabete e Obesità

• Guidare la strategia medica globale modellando la generazione di prove e guidando lo sviluppo del prodotto in tutto il ciclo di vita

• Guidare l'allineamento interfunzionale collegando le squadre R&D, commerciali e mediche per ottenere risultati di impatto

• Costruire un forte impegno esterno collaborando con professionisti sanitari, esperti scientifici e associazioni

• Fornire istruzione medica di alta qualità e comunicazione scientifica ai fornitori di assistenza sanitaria e agli stakeholder interni

• Tradurre prove scientifiche in contenuti chiari e pertinenti per sostenere i mercati e influenzare la pratica clinica

• Monitoraggio degli sviluppi scientifici e delle attività competitive per informare la strategia e rafforzare il posizionamento

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare una forte esperienza negli affari medici e scientifici all'interno dell'alimentazione clinica o degli ambienti farmaceutici

• Applicare la capacità di condurre strategie di generazione di prove e tradurre dati complessi in insight attuabili

• Utilizzo di forti capacità di gestione degli stakeholder per influenzare team interfunzionali ed esperti esterni

• Collaborare efficacemente in un'organizzazione globale di matrice per guidare l'allineamento e l'impatto

• Comunicare fluentemente in inglese

• Portare la collaborazione, il pensiero fresco, domande audaci, il rispetto e una mentalità positiva e orientata al benessere.

• Dimostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo.

A Nestlé in Svizzera, mettiamo le persone al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo.

I nostri vantaggi sono progettati per sostenere la crescita e il benessere, in modo da poter prosperare sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati a un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista video con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Rivediamo le domande come vengono ricevute e chiudiamo il ruolo una volta che viene identificata una forte lista di candidati rilevanti, in modo da incoraggiarvi ad applicare presto. Tutte le informazioni sono trattate con riservatezza.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronto a essere una forza per il bene?

Applicare ora e accelerare il cambiamento

C'est l'occasion pour vous de prendre en main, d'accroître votre expertise et de stimuler l'innovation fondée sur des données probantes qui améliore les résultats en santé des patients et des populations à l'échelle.

Comment vous aurez un impact en tant que chef de file mondial des affaires médicales – Diabète et obésité

• Diriger la stratégie médicale mondiale en formant la génération de preuves et en guidant le développement de produits tout au long du cycle de vie

• Conduire l'alignement interfonctionnel en reliant les équipes de R-D, commerciales et médicales pour obtenir des résultats positifs

• Renforcer l'engagement externe en partenariat avec les professionnels de la santé, les experts scientifiques et les associations

• Fournir une éducation médicale de qualité et une communication scientifique aux prestataires de soins de santé et aux parties prenantes internes

• Traduire des preuves scientifiques en contenu clair et pertinent pour soutenir les marchés et influencer la pratique clinique

• Suivre les développements scientifiques et les activités compétitives pour éclairer la stratégie et renforcer le positionnement

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter une solide expertise dans les affaires médicales et scientifiques dans les milieux cliniques de la nutrition ou pharmaceutique

• Application de la capacité de diriger des stratégies de production de données probantes et de traduire des données complexes en éléments concrets

• Utiliser de solides compétences en gestion des parties prenantes pour influencer les équipes interfonctionnelles et les experts externes

• Collaborer efficacement dans une organisation matricielle mondiale pour favoriser l'alignement et l'impact

• Communiquer couramment en anglais

• Apporter la collaboration, la pensée nouvelle, les questions audacieuses, le respect et un état d'esprit positif et axé sur le bien-être.

• Démontrer courage, collaboration, rapidité et apprentissage continu.

Chez Nestlé en Suisse, nous mettons les gens au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Options de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybride (pour les rôles de bureau)

• Jours fériés payés au-delà des exigences légales

• Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour développer votre carrière

• Prime basée sur les performances

• Contribution en soins de santé et accès au Programme d'aide aux employés

• Une forte contribution de l'employeur à votre régime de retraite

• Congé parental généreux et solutions globales de soutien familial

• Réductions attrayantes pour les employés pour divers produits et services

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous sommes déterminés à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sûr pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend généralement une entrevue vidéo avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents a été établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de manière confidentielle.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé ne communiquera qu'avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses courriel officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à aucune étape du processus d'embauche.

Prêt à être une force pour le bien?

Appliquer maintenant et accélérer le changement

jobs.title: Instandhaltungsmechaniker/in
jobs.description:
Positions Übersicht

Standort: Basel, Schweiz

Unternehmen: Nestlé Suisse SA
Beschäftigungsgrad: 100%
Vertragsart: Unbefristet

Anstellungsbeginn: per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Benefits:

• Min. 25 Tage Ferien pro Jahr, je nach Alter mehr

• 18 Wochen bezahlter Mutterschaftsurlaub, 4 Wochen bezahlter Vaterschaftsurlaub

• 13. Monatslohn und Bonusmöglichkeit

• Leistungen der Pensionskasse über dem gesetzlichen Minimum

• Beiträge an die Krankentaggeldversicherung zu 100% vom Arbeitgeber bezahlt

• Standorte mit agilen und kollaborativen Arbeitsplätzen

• Dynamisches und internationales Arbeitsumfeld

• Viele Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen Entwicklung und Entfaltung

Kurzüberblick Position

Die Fabrik Basel ist ein leistungsstarker Produktionsbetrieb der Nestlé Suisse S.A. und stellt kulinarische Produkte der Marken THOMY für das In- und Ausland her.

Für unsere Abteilung Produktion suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als Instandhaltungsmechaniker/in .

Ein Tag im Leben eines/-r Instandhaltungsmechaniker/in

• Durchführung von Instandhaltungs- und Wartungsarbeiten an Abfüllanlagen

• Analyse und Behebung von Störungen im Tagesgeschäft

• Fertigung von Ersatzteilen oder Beschaffung beim Hersteller

• Identifizierung von Optimierungsmöglichkeiten sowie Umsetzung technischer Verbesserungen

• Begleitung des Linienpersonals bei Format- und Produktwechseln

• Ausbildung des Linienpersonals in technischen Kompetenzen

• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Sicherheits- und Qualitätsstandards

Das macht Sie erfolgreich

• Abgeschlossene Lehre als (Poly-)Mechaniker/in, Industriemechaniker/in, Mechatroniker/in oder verwandte Berufe

• Erfahrung im Instandhaltungsbereich, vorzugsweise in einem industriellen Lebensmittelbetrieb

• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Drehen, Schweissen, Fräsen und Anfertigen von technischen Zeichnungen

• Erfahrung in vorbeugender Instandhaltung, kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozessen und 5S von Vorteil

• Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Offen und transparent kommunizierende/r Teamplayer/in

• Sehr gute mündliche sowie schriftliche Deutschkenntnisse

• Bereitschaft zu flexiblen Arbeitseinsätzen in einem vorwiegenden 2- Schichtbetrieb von Montag bis Freitag und Bereitschaft zum Pikettdienst

Wir bei Nestlé wollen dazu beitragen, eine bessere und gesündere Welt zu gestalten, Menschen zu einem gesünderen Leben zu inspirieren und in einem Umfang und Tempo zu arbeiten, das einen Unterschied machte. Wir tun dies, indem wir ein vielfältiges, freundliches, unterstützendes und kollaboratives Umfeld fördern, das positiven Wandel hervorruft, Innovationen begrüsst und Menschen und Teams befähigt, zu gewinnen.

Unser Ziel ist es, freundliche, respektvolle und inspirierende Teammitglieder einzustellen, denen das Leben der Menschen, die wir jeden Tag berühren, am Herzen liegt.

Be a force for good. Werden Sie Teil von Nestlé und senden uns Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse, Diplome etc.) auf Deutsch direkt online zu.

Posizione panoramica breve

Fabrik Basel è una società di produzione ad alte prestazioni di Nestlé Suisse S.A. e produce prodotti culinari del marchio THOMY per la Germania e l'estero.

Per il nostro reparto di produzione stiamo cercando una personalità impegnata come meccanico di manutenzione immediatamente o di accordo.

Una giornata nella vita di un meccanico di manutenzione

• Lavori di manutenzione e manutenzione su impianti di imbottigliamento

• Analisi e risoluzione delle interruzioni nel business quotidiano

• Produzione di pezzi di ricambio o di approvvigionamento dal produttore

• Identificazione delle possibilità di ottimizzazione e implementazione dei miglioramenti tecnici

• Personale di linea di accompagnamento per le modifiche di formato e prodotto

• Competenza tecnica formazione del personale di linea

• Garantire il rispetto degli standard di sicurezza e qualità

Questo li rende di successo.

• Apprendistato completo come (poli)meccanico, meccanico industriale, meccatronica o professioni correlate

• Esperienza nella manutenzione, preferibilmente in un'industria alimentare

• Conoscenza approfondita della tornitura, della saldatura, della fresatura e dei disegni tecnici

• Esperienza nella manutenzione preventiva, processi di miglioramento continuo e 5S vantaggiosi

• Metodo di lavoro indipendente, strutturato e orientato alla soluzione

• Giocatore di squadra aperto e trasparente

• Molto buone capacità orali e scritte tedesche

• Prontezza per incarichi di lavoro flessibili in un'operazione principalmente a 2 turni da lunedì a venerdì e disponibilità per Picettdienst

A Nestlé, vogliamo aiutare a plasmare un mondo migliore e più sano, ispirare le persone a vivere la vita più sana, e lavorare a una scala e ritmo che ha fatto la differenza. Lo facciamo promuovendo un ambiente diversificato, amichevole, solidale e collaborativo che ispira cambiamenti positivi, accoglie l'innovazione e consente alle persone e ai team di vincere.

Il nostro obiettivo è quello di assumere membri di squadra amichevoli, rispettosi e ispiranti che si preoccupano della vita delle persone che tocchiamo ogni giorno.

Sii una forza per il bene. Entra a far parte di Nestlé e inviaci i tuoi documenti di candidatura completi (lettera di motivazione, CV, certificati, diplomi, ecc.) direttamente online in tedesco.

Company: Nestlé Suisse SA
Level of employment: 100%
Contract type: Perpetual

Start of employment: immediately or by agreement

Benefits:

• Min. 25 days of vacation per year, more depending on age

• 18 weeks paid maternity leave, 4 weeks paid paternity leave

• Pension fund benefits above the statutory minimum

• Contributions to day sickness allowance insurance paid 100% by the employer

• Locations with agile and collaborative workplaces

• Dynamic and international working environment

• Many opportunities for personal development and development

Short overview position

Fabrik Basel is a high-performance production company of Nestlé Suisse S.A. and produces culinary products of the THOMY brand for Germany and abroad.

For our production department we are looking for a committed personality as a maintenance mechanic immediately or by agreement.

A day in the life of a maintenance mechanic

• Maintenance and servicing work on bottling plants

• Analysis and resolution of disruptions in day-to-day business

• Production of spare parts or procurement from the manufacturer

• Identification of optimization possibilities and implementation of technical improvements

• Accompanying line staff for format and product changes

• Technical competence training of line staff

• Ensuring compliance with safety and quality standards

This makes them successful.

• Completed apprenticeship as (poly)mechanic, industrial mechanic, mechatronics or related professions

• Experience in maintenance, preferably in an industrial food business

• In-depth knowledge of turning, welding, milling and making technical drawings

• Experience in preventive maintenance, continuous improvement processes and 5S beneficial

• Independent, structured and solution-oriented working method

• Openly and transparently communicating team player

• Very good oral and written German skills

• Readiness for flexible work assignments in a mainly 2-shift operation from Monday to Friday and readiness for Picettdienst

At Nestlé, we want to help shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live healthier lives, and work at a scale and pace that made a difference. jobs.title: Opérateur.trice de production (H/F/D)
jobs.description:
Chez Nespresso Suisse nous pensons qu’il est possible d’élever l’univers du café et nous voulons contribuer positivement à changer les vies et les paysages pour le mieux. Élu meilleur employeur 2025, nous plaçons chacun de nos 14 000 collaborateurs, sans exception, au cœur de notre réussite. Pour y parvenir, nous adoptons quatre comportements essentiels : « we Inspire, we Care, we Act, and we iNnovate ». Et vous ? Voulez-vous nous accompagner dans cette aventure passionnante ? Rejoignez l’équipe Nespresso ! Et réimaginez la nature du café. Réimaginez votre avenir.

Instantané du poste

Lieux : Romont, Switzerland

Entité : Centre de Production Nespresso
Taux : Temps plein 100%

Type de contrat : Contrat indéterminé

Ce que nous offrons chez Nespresso

De réelles opportunités d’évolution de carrière et de développement personnel

Un cadre de travail flexible facilitant la créativité et la collaboration

Une culture fondée sur la bienveillance et l’inclusivité, où chacun peut être soi-même

La qualité et la durabilité au cœur de notre identité et une vision essentielle pour favoriser le changement positif L’opportunité de travailler pour une entreprise certifiée B Corp, et l'une des marques les plus fiables et appréciées à l’échelle mondiale

Au cours du processus de recrutement, n’hésitez pas à nous en parler pour en savoir plus !

Découvrez notre page Linkedin Nespresso Centres de production

Découvrez nos métiers Métiers Nespresso - YouTube

Résumé du poste

En tant qu’Opérateur.trice de production (H/F/D) , vous êtes responsable de la conduite d’une ligne de production automatisée, en horaires d’équipe 4x8.

Une journée dans la vie d’un(e) Opérateur.trice de production (H/F/D)

• Conduire les installations de production automatisées

• Réapprovisionner les lignes de production

• Gérer le stock des matières premières par informatique

• Analyser les différentes causes de pannes et remonter les problèmes

• Effectuer les réglages et la maintenance de premier niveau

• Contribuer à la mise en application de la méthodologie TPM (Total Performance Management)

• Effectuer et documenter les contrôles qualité

• Assurer la transmission de l’information lors du passage de consignes

• Participer à l’amélioration continue

• S’assurer de la bonne application du 5S et nettoyage des lignes

Vos atouts pour réussir

• CFC d’Opérateur de machines automatisées ou formation dans un domaine technique/alimentaire

• Expérience dans l’industrie agro-alimentaire ou pharmaceutique

• Être disposé à faire des horaires d’équipes

• Avoir une excellente maitrise du français orale et écrite

• Avoir un permis de conduire et un véhicule à disposition

• Être capable de prendre des initiatives et être autonome dans son travail

• La connaissance de SAP est un atout

• Maîtrise des outils informatiques standards (Word, Excel, Powerpoint)

Avantages

• Primes d’équipe mensuelles

• Pauses rémunérées

• 5 semaines de vacances + heures de compensations

• Pas d’astreinte

• Visibilité annuelle du planning (aucune heure supplémentaire), incluant des jours de repos en semaine favorisant votre organisation personnelle

• Possibilité de formation et de développement internes

• Caisse de pension avec excellentes contributions de l’employeur

• Participation financière à l’assurance maladie

• Politique parentalité avantageuse

• Restaurant d’entreprise sur place avec menus à prix subventionnés

• Parking gratuit et bornes de recharge pour voitures électriques

• Nombreux avantages auprès du Club Nespresso

Chez Nespresso, nous avons bâti une culture fondée sur la bienveillance et l’inclusion, où chacun peut être soi-même, tout en grandissant avec l’entreprise. Nous innovons, nous osons essayer de nouvelles choses, nous apprenons et évoluons dans un environnement numérique et connecté où tout va très vite. Au sein d’une équipe diverse regroupant plus de 90 nationalités dans 58 pays, vous pouvez prendre part à cette culture innovante, dans laquelle les personnes se soutiennent et s’entraident. Une culture dans laquelle chacun est encouragé à remettre en question le statu quo et à avoir un impact sur l’avenir de l’une des plus grandes entreprises durables au monde. Quel que soit le rôle que vous jouerez, vous découvrirez que vous pouvez réellement changer les choses et partager votre enthousiasme. Rejoignez ce lieu où vous pourrez vous épanouir, trouver une appartenance et l’inspiration pour devenir le meilleur de vous-même et vous surpasser.

jobs.title: Engineering Specialist
jobs.description:
Position snapshot

Location: Konolfingen, Switzerland

Company: Nestlé Research Konolfingen

Act. Rate: 80-100%

Type of contract: Permanent contract

Language: Fluent in English (B2 or better) and German (an advantage)

What we offer at Nestlé

Flexible work policies in terms of core hours. Please talk to us during the recruitment process about what flexibility could look like for you!

Genuine opportunities for career and personal development

Working in an international environment with the possibility to work worldwide after a successful experience in Konolfingen

Attractive additional benefits

Position summary

Our Nestlé Research and Development Center in Konolfingen (NRDK), Switzerland, develops for Nestlé worldwide, new products, processes and packaging concepts in the areas of Milk, plant-based and Nutrition products. This includes various process and filling technologies for liquid, powder or sterile products. In addition, it also provides technical assistance and engineering support for major Capital Investment Projects (CAPEX) to our factories.

As a member of our local Site-Engineering team you will support with your technical expertise and in close collaboration with your colleagues the daily pilot plant operations as well as the evaluation, design and implementation of local investment projects.

We offer a dynamic, inclusive, and international working environment with many opportunities across different companies, functions, and regions. Don’t miss the opportunity to join us and work with different teams in an agile and diverse context.

Daily activities of an Engineering Specialist

• Prepare high-level feasibility studies by asking the right questions to get a broad picture without going into too many details for new process and product ideas

• Prepare projects in further details to submit budget requests taking in account the various internal and external stakeholders of the NRDK

• Lead and execute the projects on site safely and in close collaboration with the various team members and specific operational functions leading to a successful commissioning, start-up and documented handover

• Assist our technicians/operators in troubleshooting and more complex root cause analysis on site

• Help to improve the asset intensity of our pilot plant and production facilities with detailed data analysis and specific process know-how

• Develop and drive sustainable solutions to meet our net zero goal by challenging and improving the status-quo

• Support the exploration and development of new technologies/products and help to qualify and industrialize them

What will make you successful

• Engineering degree (preferably process or mechanical engineering)

• Experience in process engineering and food industry including hygienic requirements are an advantage but not a must

• Excellent networking and communication skills

• End to end (E2E)-mindset (start projects with a clearly defined and well aligned scope ending up in successful handover including proper documentation)

• Passionate about making a difference in the professional environment

• Strong problem-solving skills as part of a bigger team and willing to apply them also in the field

• Full commitment to compliance (legal, safety, quality, finance) for all activities

• Willingness to develop specific expertise in defined areas to be the local subject matter expert

At Nestlé, we want to help shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live healthier lives and deliver impact at a scale and pace that makes a difference. We do this by fostering a diverse, friendly, supportive, and collaborative environment, that creates positive disruption, embraces innovation, and empowers people and teams to win.
We aim to hire friendly, respectful, inspiring people who care about the people’s lives that we touch every single day.
Be a force for good. Join Nestlé and visit us on www.nestle.com.

Cosa offriamo a Nestlé

Politiche di lavoro flessibili in termini di ore di base. Si prega di parlare con noi durante il processo di reclutamento su quale flessibilità potrebbe sembrare per voi!

Opportunità di carriera e sviluppo personale

Lavorare in un ambiente internazionale con la possibilità di lavorare in tutto il mondo dopo un'esperienza di successo a Konolfingen

Vantaggi aggiuntivi interessanti

Sintesi della posizione

Il nostro Centro di Ricerca e Sviluppo Nestlé a Konolfingen (NRDK), Svizzera, si sviluppa per Nestlé in tutto il mondo, nuovi prodotti, processi e concetti di imballaggio nei settori dei prodotti Latte, a base di piante e Nutrition. Questo include varie tecnologie di processo e di riempimento per prodotti liquidi, in polvere o sterili. Inoltre, fornisce assistenza tecnica e supporto ingegneristico per i principali progetti di investimento di capitale (CAPEX) alle nostre fabbriche.

In qualità di membro del nostro team di Site-Engineering locale, supporterai con la tua competenza tecnica e in stretta collaborazione con i tuoi colleghi le operazioni quotidiane degli impianti pilota, nonché la valutazione, la progettazione e l'implementazione di progetti di investimento locali.

Offriamo un ambiente di lavoro dinamico, inclusivo e internazionale con molte opportunità in diverse aziende, funzioni e regioni. Non perdere l’opportunità di unirsi a noi e lavorare con diverse squadre in un contesto agile e vario.

Attività quotidiane di uno specialista di ingegneria

• Preparare studi di fattibilità di alto livello facendo le domande giuste per ottenere un quadro ampio senza entrare in troppi dettagli per nuove idee di processo e di prodotto

• Preparare i progetti in ulteriori dettagli per presentare richieste di bilancio tenendo conto delle varie parti interessate interne ed esterne della NRDK

• Guidare ed eseguire i progetti in loco in modo sicuro e in stretta collaborazione con i vari membri del team e specifiche funzioni operative che portano ad una messa in servizio di successo, start-up e consegna documentata

• Assistere i nostri tecnici/operatori nella risoluzione dei problemi e nell'analisi delle cause radice più complessa sul sito

• Aiuta a migliorare l'intensità patrimoniale del nostro impianto pilota e delle strutture produttive con analisi dettagliate dei dati e know-how di processo specifico

• Sviluppare e guidare soluzioni sostenibili per soddisfare il nostro obiettivo netto zero sfidando e migliorando lo status-quo

• Sostenere l'esplorazione e lo sviluppo di nuove tecnologie / prodotti e contribuire a qualificarli e industrializzarli

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Laurea in ingegneria (preferibilmente processo o ingegneria meccanica)

• L'esperienza nell'ingegneria dei processi e nell'industria alimentare, compresi i requisiti igienici sono un vantaggio ma non un must

• Ottimi competenze di networking e comunicazione

• Fine to end (E2E)-mindset (progetti di avvio con un campo di applicazione chiaramente definito e ben allineato che finiscono per una consegna di successo, compresa la documentazione corretta)

• Appassionato a fare la differenza nell'ambiente professionale

• Forte capacità di problem solving come parte di un team più grande e disposto ad applicarli anche nel campo

• Completo impegno a rispettare (legale, sicurezza, qualità, finanza) per tutte le attività

• La volontà di sviluppare competenze specifiche in aree definite per essere l'esperto di materia locale

A Nestlé, vogliamo aiutare a plasmare un mondo migliore e più sano, ispirare le persone a vivere vite più sane e dare impatto a una scala e ritmo che fa la differenza. Lo facciamo promuovendo un ambiente diversificato, amichevole, solidale e collaborativo, che crea interruzioni positive, abbraccia l'innovazione, e consente alle persone e ai team di vincere.
Ci proponiamo di assumere persone amichevoli, rispettose e stimolanti che si preoccupano della vita della gente che tocchiamo ogni giorno.
Sii una forza per il bene. Unisciti a Nestlé e visitaci su www.nestle.com.

Bei Nestlé möchten wir dazu beitragen, eine bessere und gesündere Welt zu gestalten, Menschen zu einem gesünderen Leben zu inspirieren und Auswirkungen in einem Ausmaß und Tempo zu erzielen, das einen Unterschied macht. jobs.description:
Lieu : Orbe, Suisse

Entité : Nestlé Suisse S.A.

Durée : Stage de 6 mois dès février 2027 (date d’entrée flexible)

Envie de piloter un projet concret au cœur de notre système qualité ?

Dans le cadre du déploiement de SenseIT, la solution digitale de Nestlé dédiée à la gestion des évaluations sensorielles, nous recherchons un·e stagiaire capable de piloter ce projet avec une très grande autonomie. Cette solution permet notamment de digitaliser les évaluations sensorielles, de faciliter l’intégration avec SAP, d’accéder à des informations en temps réel et de renforcer la conformité des processus.

Votre mission

Au sein de l’équipe Qualité de la Fabrique Nescafé d’Orbe, vous contribuerez à la digitalisation et à l’amélioration continue de notre système de management de la qualité. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Qualité et opérationnelles et les différentes parties prenantes du site.

Ce stage s’adresse à une personne proactive, structurée et responsable, capable d’organiser son travail, de solliciter les bons interlocuteurs et de faire avancer ses sujets avec un encadrement limité. Le stage est ouvert uniquement aux étudiant·e·s en cours d’étude ou ayant obtenu leur diplôme il y a moins d’une année.

Comment vous créerez de l’impact

• Prendre en charge le projet SenseIT avec un haut niveau d’autonomie, de la compréhension du besoin jusqu’au déploiement de la solution.

• Analyser les pratiques actuelles, identifier les opportunités d’amélioration et proposer des solutions simples, efficaces et adaptées aux besoins opérationnels.

• Collecter, structurer et exploiter les informations nécessaires au projet en s’appuyant sur la documentation, les standards et les parties prenantes.

• Coordonner les échanges avec les différents acteurs, assurer le suivi des actions et contribuer à l’alignement des équipes.

• Tester les solutions, documenter les résultats et développer les standards, procédures et supports garantissant une utilisation durable de l’outil.

• Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l’adoption de la solution et suivre l’avancement du projet à l’aide d’indicateurs de performance.

• Contribuer plus largement à la digitalisation et à l’amélioration continue des processus qualité.

Ce qui fera votre réussite

• Vous suivez une formation supérieure en ingénierie, amélioration continue, systèmes industriels ou dans un domaine similaire ou obtenu votre diplôme il y a moins d’un an.

• Vous faites preuve d’une grande autonomie, de curiosité et d’esprit d’initiative, et savez progresser dans un projet même lorsque toutes les réponses ne sont pas immédiatement disponibles.

• Vous êtes capable de transformer un objectif en plan d’action concret, de définir vos priorités et de mener plusieurs activités en parallèle.

• Vous disposez d’un solide esprit d’analyse et savez rechercher, structurer et synthétiser efficacement l’information.

• Vous êtes rigoureux·se, organisé·e et attentif·ve aux détails.

• Vous savez communiquer avec des interlocuteurs variés et créer une dynamique de collaboration.

• Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils digitaux et Microsoft Office (dont Copilot) ; une expérience en gestion de données, digitalisation ou visualisation de données constitue un atout.

• Vous communiquez couramment en français ; l’anglais constitue un atout.

• Une connaissance des systèmes de management de la qualité, de l’amélioration continue ou d’un environnement industriel est un avantage.

Prêt·e à relever le défi ? Si vous recherchez un stage durant lequel vous pourrez réellement prendre des responsabilités, gérer votre propre projet et contribuer concrètement à la transformation du système qualité de notre fabrique, cette opportunité est faite pour vous.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: Orbe, Svizzera

Entità: Nestlé Svizzera S.A.

Durata: stage di 6 mesi dal febbraio 2027 (data di entrata flessibile)

Vuoi condurre un progetto concreto nel cuore del nostro sistema di qualità?

Nell'ambito dell'implementazione di SenseIT, la soluzione digitale di Nestlé dedicata alla gestione delle valutazioni sensoriali, stiamo cercando uno stagista in grado di pilotare questo progetto con grande autonomia. Questa soluzione consente di digitalizzare le valutazioni sensoriali, facilitare l'integrazione con SAP, accedere in tempo reale alle informazioni e migliorare la conformità dei processi.

La tua missione

All'interno del team Quality del Fabrique Nescafé di Orbe, contribuirai alla digitalizzazione e al miglioramento continuo del nostro sistema di gestione della qualità. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di qualità e operativi e le varie parti interessate sul sito.

Questo corso è inteso per una persona proattiva, strutturata e responsabile, in grado di organizzare il suo lavoro, sollecitare gli interlocutori giusti e spostare i suoi soggetti avanti con supervisione limitata. Il tirocinio è aperto solo agli studenti che sono nel corso di studio o hanno ottenuto il diploma meno di un anno fa.

Come creare impatto

• Sostenere il progetto SenseIT con un alto livello di autonomia, dalla comprensione della necessità di implementare la soluzione.

• Analizzare le pratiche attuali, identificare le opportunità di miglioramento e proporre soluzioni semplici, efficienti e personalizzate alle esigenze operative.

• Raccogliere, strutturare e utilizzare le informazioni del progetto in base alla documentazione, agli standard e agli stakeholder.

• Coordinare gli scambi con diversi attori, monitorare le azioni e contribuire all'allineamento delle squadre.

• Soluzioni di prova, risultati dei documenti e sviluppo di standard, procedure e supporti per garantire un uso sostenibile dello strumento.

• Sostenere gli utenti nell'adottare la soluzione e monitorare i progressi del progetto con gli indicatori di performance.

• Per contribuire più ampiamente alla digitalizzazione e al miglioramento continuo dei processi di qualità.

Che cosa farà il vostro successo

• Si sta subendo una formazione avanzata in ingegneria, miglioramento continuo, sistemi industriali o in un campo simile o laureato meno di un anno fa.

• Si mostra grande autonomia, curiosità e iniziativa, e sapere come progredire in un progetto anche quando non tutte le risposte sono immediatamente disponibili.

• Siete in grado di trasformare un obiettivo in un piano d'azione concreto, definire le vostre priorità e svolgere diverse attività in parallelo.

• Hai una forte mentalità analitica e sai come cercare efficacemente, strutturare e sintetizzare le informazioni.

• Siete rigorosi, organizzati e attenti ai dettagli.

• È possibile comunicare con una varietà di persone e creare una dinamica di collaborazione.

• Sei a tuo agio con strumenti digitali e Microsoft Office (incluso Copilot); Esperienza nella gestione dei dati, digitalizzazione o visualizzazione è un bene.

• Si comunica fluentemente in francese; l'inglese è un bene.

• La conoscenza dei sistemi di gestione della qualità, il miglioramento continuo o un ambiente industriale è un vantaggio.

Pronto a rispondere alla sfida? Se siete alla ricerca di uno stage durante il quale si può davvero prendere la responsabilità, gestire il proprio progetto e dare un contributo concreto alla trasformazione del sistema di qualità della nostra fabbrica, questa opportunità è fatta per voi.
descriptionByLocale.en:

Duration: 6 month internship from February 2027 (flexible entry date)

Want to lead a concrete project at the heart of our quality system?

As part of the deployment of SenseIT, Nestlé's digital solution dedicated to the management of sensory assessments, we are looking for an intern able to pilot this project with great autonomy. This solution makes it possible to digitize sensory assessments, facilitate integration with SAP, access real-time information and enhance process compliance.

Your Mission

Within the Quality team of the Fabrique Nescafé in Orbe, you will contribute to the digitisation and continuous improvement of our quality management system. You will work closely with the Quality and Operational Teams and the various stakeholders on the site.

This course is intended for a proactive, structured and responsible person, able to organize his/her work, solicit the right interlocutors and move his/her subjects forward with limited supervision. The traineeship is open only to students who are in the course of study or have obtained their diploma less than a year ago.

How you will create impact

• Support the SenseIT project with a high level of autonomy, from understanding the need to deploying the solution.

• Analyze current practices, identify opportunities for improvement and propose simple, efficient and tailored solutions to operational needs.

• Collect, structure and use project information based on documentation, standards and stakeholders.

• Coordinate exchanges with different actors, monitor actions and contribute to the alignment of teams.

• Test solutions, document results, and develop standards, procedures and supports to ensure sustainable use of the tool.

• Support users in adopting the solution and monitor project progress with performance indicators.

• To contribute more widely to digitalisation and continuous improvement of quality processes.

What Will Make Your Success

• You are undergoing advanced training in engineering, continuous improvement, industrial systems or in a similar field or graduated less than a year ago.

• You show great autonomy, curiosity and initiative, and know how to progress in a project even when not all the answers are immediately available.

• You are able to transform a goal into a concrete action plan, define your priorities and carry out several activities in parallel.

• You have a strong analytical mindset and know how to effectively search, structure and synthesize information.

• You are rigorous, organized and attentive to details.

• You can communicate with a variety of people and create a dynamic of collaboration.

• You are comfortable with digital tools and Microsoft Office (including Copilot); Experience in data management, digitization or visualization is an asset.

• You communicate fluently in French; English is an asset.

• Knowledge of quality management systems, continuous improvement or an industrial environment is an advantage.

Ready to meet the challenge? If you are looking for an internship during which you can really take responsibility, manage your own project and make a concrete contribution to the transformation of the quality system of our factory, this opportunity is made for you.
descriptionByLocale.de:

Möchten Sie ein konkretes Projekt im Herzen unseres Qualitätssystems leiten?

Diese Lösung ermöglicht es, sensorische Bewertungen zu digitalisieren, die Integration mit SAP zu erleichtern, auf Echtzeitinformationen zuzugreifen und die Prozesskonformität zu verbessern.

Deine Mission

Im Qualitätsteam der Fabrique Nescafé in Orbe tragen Sie zur Digitalisierung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unseres Qualitätsmanagementsystems bei. Sie werden eng mit den Qualitäts- und Betriebsteams und den verschiedenen Stakeholdern auf der Website zusammenarbeiten.

Dieser Kurs richtet sich an eine proaktive, strukturierte und verantwortliche Person, die in der Lage ist, ihre Arbeit zu organisieren, die richtigen Gesprächspartner zu erbitten und ihre Themen mit begrenzter Aufsicht voranzubringen. Das Praktikum steht nur Studierenden offen, die sich im Studium befinden oder ihr Diplom vor weniger als einem Jahr erworben haben.

Wie Sie Wirkung erzielen

• Unterstützen Sie das SenseIT-Projekt mit einem hohen Maß an Autonomie, vom Verständnis der Notwendigkeit bis zur Bereitstellung der Lösung.

• Analysieren Sie aktuelle Praktiken, identifizieren Sie Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten und schlagen Sie einfache, effiziente und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für betriebliche Anforderungen vor.

• Sammeln, Strukturieren und Verwenden von Projektinformationen basierend auf Dokumentation, Standards und Stakeholdern.

• Koordinieren Sie den Austausch mit verschiedenen Akteuren, überwachen Sie die Aktionen und tragen Sie zur Ausrichtung der Teams bei.

• Testen Sie Lösungen, dokumentieren Sie Ergebnisse und entwickeln Sie Standards, Verfahren und Unterstützung, um eine nachhaltige Nutzung des Tools zu gewährleisten.

• Unterstützen Sie die Benutzer bei der Annahme der Lösung und überwachen Sie den Projektfortschritt mit Leistungsindikatoren.

• Einen breiteren Beitrag zur Digitalisierung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Qualitätsprozessen zu leisten.

Was wird Ihren Erfolg machen

• Sie durchlaufen eine Weiterbildung in Ingenieurwissenschaften, kontinuierlicher Verbesserung, industriellen Systemen oder in einem ähnlichen Bereich oder haben vor weniger als einem Jahr einen Abschluss gemacht.

• Sie zeigen große Autonomie, Neugier und Initiative und wissen, wie Sie in einem Projekt vorankommen, auch wenn nicht alle Antworten sofort verfügbar sind.

• Sie können ein Ziel in einen konkreten Aktionsplan umwandeln, Ihre Prioritäten definieren und mehrere Aktivitäten parallel durchführen.

• Sie haben eine starke analytische Denkweise und wissen, wie Sie Informationen effektiv suchen, strukturieren und synthetisieren können.

• Sie sind streng, organisiert und aufmerksam auf Details.

• Sie können mit einer Vielzahl von Menschen kommunizieren und eine Dynamik der Zusammenarbeit schaffen.

• Sie sind mit digitalen Tools und Microsoft Office (einschließlich Copilot) vertraut; Erfahrung in Datenmanagement, Digitalisierung oder Visualisierung ist eine Bereicherung.

• Sie kommunizieren fließend auf Französisch; Englisch ist ein Gewinn.

• Kenntnisse über Qualitätsmanagementsysteme, kontinuierliche Verbesserung oder ein industrielles Umfeld sind von Vorteil.

Bereit für die Herausforderung? Wenn Sie ein Praktikum suchen, bei dem Sie wirklich Verantwortung übernehmen, Ihr eigenes Projekt leiten und einen konkreten Beitrag zur Transformation des Qualitätssystems unserer Fabrik leisten können, ist diese Gelegenheit für Sie gegeben.

• Coordonner les échanges avec les différents acteurs, assurer le suivi des actions et contribuer à l’alignement des équipes.

• Tester les solutions, documenter les résultats et développer les standards, procédures et supports garantissant une utilisation durable de l’outil.

• Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l’adoption de la solution et suivre l’avancement du projet à l’aide d’indicateurs de performance.

• Vous faites preuve d’une grande autonomie, de curiosité et d’esprit d’initiative, et savez progresser dans un projet même lorsque toutes les réponses ne sont pas immédiatement disponibles.

jobs.title: Demand & Supply Planner

titleByLocale.it: Pianificatore di domanda e di alimentazione

jobs.description:
Position snapshot

Nestlé Waters, Switzerland, Henniez

Permanent Contract

80-100%

Position summary

In this role, you will provide Nestlé Waters with the 18-month rolling best estimate of Customer Demand and improve Demand Plan accuracy. Furthermore, you will manage supply of finished products at different warehouses and manage the finished goods produced by co-packers. The main goal will be to enhance the Supply Chain responsiveness in fulfilling customer demand at optimal cost.

A day in a life of a Demand & Supply Planner:

• Ensure supply & availability of products to fulfil deliveries on time, at the right place with the correct freshness at warehouse level

• Use appropriate statistical models and parameters, interpret results to generate accurate base demand forecasts

• Drive fast, appropriate actions to minimize the impact of deviations from the Demand Plan, and communicate the implemented actions to the stakeholders

• Capture, prioritize, analyze and input Generating Demand events; customer, consumer & competitor information

• Provide Generating Demand teams with inputs on a regular basis regarding product launches, portfolio optimization, rationale of commercial decisions, promotions and customer behaviour

• Build and maintain good communication and collaboration within both Supply Chain and Generating Demand, Manufacturing, Quality and Finance, in order to deliver and satisfy our customers at optimal costs

• Support different processes within Supply Chain

What makes you successful:

• University Degree with previous internships performed ideally in Supply Chain or Commercial CFC with maturity or equivalent level with at least two years’ experience in a similar position or relevant operational experience in Supply Chain at market/business level

• Strong analytical skills

• Good communication and collaboration skills to deal with different departments (Marketing, Factory, Transport)

• Fluent in French & English any other languages is a plus

• Good command of Excel and SAP experience

Sintesi della posizione

In questo ruolo, fornirai Nestlé Waters con la migliore stima della domanda del cliente di rotolamento di 18 mesi e migliorerà l'accuratezza del piano di domanda. Inoltre, gestirai la fornitura di prodotti finiti in diversi magazzini e gestirai i prodotti finiti prodotti da co-packers. L'obiettivo principale sarà quello di migliorare la reattività della Supply Chain nel soddisfare la domanda del cliente a un costo ottimale.

Una giornata in una vita di un Pianificatore di domanda e di alimentazione:

• Assicurare la fornitura e la disponibilità di prodotti per soddisfare le consegne in tempo, al posto giusto con la corretta freschezza a livello di magazzino

• Utilizzare modelli e parametri statistici appropriati, interpretare i risultati per generare previsioni accurate della domanda di base

• Guidare azioni rapide e appropriate per minimizzare l'impatto delle deviazioni dal Piano di Domanda e comunicare le azioni attuate agli stakeholder

• Acquisizione, priorità, analisi e input Generando eventi della domanda; cliente, consumatore e informazioni concorrenti

• Costruire e mantenere una buona comunicazione e collaborazione sia all'interno della Supply Chain che Generating Demand, Manufacturing, Quality and Finance, al fine di fornire e soddisfare i nostri clienti a costi ottimali

• Supporta diversi processi all'interno della Supply Chain

Cosa ti fa avere successo:

• Laurea universitaria con stage precedenti eseguita idealmente in Supply Chain o Commercial CFC con maturità o livello equivalente con almeno due anni di esperienza in una posizione simile o esperienza operativa rilevante in Supply Chain a livello di mercato / business

• Forte capacità analitiche

• Buone capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione per affrontare diversi dipartimenti (Marketing, Factory, Transport)

• Fluente in francese e inglese qualsiasi altra lingua è un plus

• Buon comando dell'esperienza Excel e SAP

Nestlé Waters, Schweiz, Henniez

Unbefristeter Vertrag

Positionsübersicht

In dieser Funktion stellen Sie Nestlé Waters die 18-monatige beste Schätzung der Kundennachfrage zur Verfügung und verbessern die Genauigkeit des Bedarfsplans. Darüber hinaus verwalten Sie die Lieferung von Fertigprodukten in verschiedenen Lagerhallen und verwalten die von Co-Packern produzierten Fertigwaren. Das Hauptziel wird es sein, die Reaktionsfähigkeit der Lieferkette bei der Erfüllung der Kundennachfrage zu optimalen Kosten zu verbessern.

Ein Tag im Leben eines Demand & Supply Planers:

• Sicherstellen der Lieferung und Verfügbarkeit von Produkten, um die Lieferungen pünktlich am richtigen Ort mit der richtigen Frische auf Lagerebene zu erfüllen

• Verwenden Sie geeignete statistische Modelle und Parameter, interpretieren Sie die Ergebnisse, um genaue Basisnachfrageprognosen zu erstellen

• Schnelle, angemessene Maßnahmen zur Minimierung der Auswirkungen von Abweichungen vom Bedarfsplan und Kommunikation der umgesetzten Maßnahmen an die Stakeholder

• Erfassung, Priorisierung, Analyse und Eingabe Generierung von Nachfrageereignissen; Kunden-, Verbraucher- und Wettbewerberinformationen

• Generierende Nachfrageteams regelmäßig mit Inputs in Bezug auf Produkteinführungen, Portfoliooptimierung, Begründung kommerzieller Entscheidungen, Promotions und Kundenverhalten

• Aufbau und Aufrechterhaltung einer guten Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit sowohl in der Lieferkette als auch bei der Generierung von Nachfrage, Fertigung, Qualität und Finanzen, um unsere Kunden zu optimalen Kosten zu liefern und zufrieden zu stellen

• Unterstützen Sie verschiedene Prozesse innerhalb der Supply Chain

Was dich erfolgreich macht:

• Universitätsabschluss mit früheren Praktika, die idealerweise in Supply Chain oder Commercial CFC mit Reife oder gleichwertigem Niveau mit mindestens zwei Jahren Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Position oder relevanter operativer Erfahrung in Supply Chain auf Markt- / Geschäftsebene durchgeführt wurden

• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten

• Gute Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit Fähigkeiten mit verschiedenen Abteilungen (Marketing, Fabrik, Transport) umzugehen

• Fließend in Französisch & Englisch alle anderen Sprachen ist ein Plus

• Gute Excel- und SAP-Erfahrung

jobs.title: Marketing ROI Insight Expert
jobs.description:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: 18-months Temporary contract

Start date: As soon as possible

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet

As a MROI Insights Expert at Nestlé Global Marketing Analytics , your mission is to turn advanced marketing effectiveness analytics into clear, actionable insights that help markets optimize media, trade and marketing investment. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with Group Marketing Analytics, technology teams, local marketing, media and consumer insight teams, zone leads, global media and finance partners. This is an opportunity to help shape and elevate a growing global function, build marketing effectiveness capabilities across the business, and make an impact at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a MROI Insights Expert

• Leading the translation of marketing mix modelling, statistics and analytics into simple, compelling insights that shape strategic brand and investment decisions.

• Building clear insight stories, recommendations and business cases that help local teams, zones, SBUs and brand teams improve marketing return on investment.

• Facilitating workshops and presentations with local markets, BEOs, zone marketing teams, Nespresso and global stakeholders to translate insights into action.

• Partnering with the data science team to validate modelling outputs, understand the value behind the analysis and identify opportunities to enhance the capability over time.

• Driving adoption of global marketing effectiveness solutions by partnering with markets, zones and global teams across diverse business contexts.

• Supporting capability development by creating learning content and practical guidance that help business teams use marketing effectiveness insights with confidence.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong expertise in marketing analytics, marketing effectiveness and marketing mix modelling within an agency, advertiser or global business environment.

• Applying a clear understanding of marketing, media, pricing and promotion models to turn complex analysis into practical business recommendations.

• Using advanced presentation, spreadsheet and business intelligence tools to create insight-led stories for senior stakeholders.

• Showing initiative, autonomy and flexibility in a fast-moving environment, while taking ownership and responsibility for delivering high-quality outcomes.

• Looking for opportunities to improve, contributing new ideas and generating trust through strong collaboration, transparency and teamwork.

• Communicating fluently and confidently in English, with the ability to present clear insights to senior stakeholders.

At Nestlé Switzerland, we care about our people.

We offer a competitive and well-rounded benefits package designed to support your growth and wellbeing at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Ubicazione: Vevey, Svizzera
Modello di lavoro: ibrido / tempo pieno
Tipo di contratto / durata: 18 mesi Contratto temporaneo

Data di inizio: appena possibile

Essere una forza per un cambiamento buono e accelerato che migliora la vita e il pianeta

In qualità di esperto MROI Insights presso Nestlé Global Marketing Analytics, la vostra missione è quella di trasformare l'analisi dell'efficacia di marketing avanzata in chiare e attuabili intuizioni che aiutano i mercati a ottimizzare i media, il commercio e gli investimenti di marketing. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con Group Marketing Analytics, team di tecnologia, marketing locale, media e team di insight per i consumatori, lead di zona, media globali e partner finanziari. Questa è un'opportunità per aiutare a modellare ed elevare una funzione globale crescente, costruire capacità di efficacia di marketing in tutto il business, e fare un impatto su scala.

Come farete un impatto come esperto di informazioni MROI

• Conducendo la traduzione di marketing mix modellazione, statistiche e analisi in semplici e convincenti intuizioni che modellano il marchio strategico e le decisioni di investimento.

• Costruire storie chiare di insight, raccomandazioni e casi di business che aiutano le squadre locali, zone, SBU e team di marca migliorare il ritorno di marketing sugli investimenti.

• Facilitare workshop e presentazioni con mercati locali, BEO, team di marketing di zone, Nespresso e stakeholder globali per tradurre intuizioni in azione.

• Collaborare con il team di data science per convalidare le uscite di modellazione, comprendere il valore dietro l'analisi e identificare le opportunità per migliorare la capacità nel tempo.

• Guidare l'adozione di soluzioni di efficacia del marketing globale collaborando con mercati, zone e team globali in diversi contesti aziendali.

• Sostenere lo sviluppo delle capacità attraverso la creazione di contenuti di apprendimento e di guida pratica che aiutano i team di affari ad utilizzare intuizioni di efficacia di marketing con fiducia.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portare una forte esperienza nell'analisi del marketing, nell'efficacia del marketing e nella modellazione di mix marketing all'interno di un'agenzia, un inserzionista o un ambiente aziendale globale.

• Applicando una chiara comprensione dei modelli di marketing, media, prezzi e promozione per trasformare l'analisi complessa in raccomandazioni pratiche di business.

• Utilizzando strumenti di presentazione, foglio di calcolo e business intelligence avanzati per creare storie guidate per gli stakeholder senior.

• Mostrando l'iniziativa, l'autonomia e la flessibilità in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione, assumendo al contempo la responsabilità di fornire risultati di alta qualità.

• Alla ricerca di opportunità per migliorare, contribuire nuove idee e generare fiducia attraverso una forte collaborazione, trasparenza e lavoro di squadra.

• Comunicare fluentemente e con fiducia in inglese, con la capacità di presentare chiare intuizioni agli stakeholder senior.

A Nestlé Svizzera, ci preoccupiamo della nostra gente.

Offriamo un pacchetto di vantaggi competitivo e ben arrotondato progettato per sostenere la vostra crescita e benessere sul lavoro e nella vita:

• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili, comprese le possibilità di lavoro ibride (per ruoli basati su ufficio)

• Vacanze pagate oltre i requisiti legali

• Opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo per crescere la tua carriera

• Bonus basato sulle prestazioni

• Contributo sanitario e accesso al programma di assistenza ai dipendenti

• Forte contributo del datore di lavoro al vostro piano pensionistico

• Generoso congedo parentale e soluzioni complete di supporto familiare

• Sconti interessanti per i dipendenti su vari prodotti e servizi

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Siamo impegnati a un'esperienza di assunzione inclusiva e rispettosa e siamo lieti di fornire alloggi ragionevoli, se necessario. I nostri luoghi di lavoro sono pienamente accessibili e supportati da una forte cultura della sicurezza, con installazioni e procedure moderne per garantire un ambiente sicuro per tutti.

Il processo di assunzione comprende tipicamente un'intervista con Talent Acquisition, un'intervista con il team di assunzione, e una discussione finale e offerta. Noi
